articleTitle: LoRa Indoor Performance: an Office Environment Case Study
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: When deploying wireless sensor networks in smart buildings, low-power, long-range communication technologies such as LoRa may offer a reliable, low data-rate alternative to existing wireless technologies. For this contribution, custom-built LoRa nodes were used to measure LoRa propagation characteristics for both the 434 MHz and 868 MHz ISM-bands. These measurements show that the presence of people has a negative impact on the quality of the LoRa link and confirm the superiority of the 434 MHz band for indoor LoRa communication.

articleTitle: A High Gain UWB Vivaldi Antenna Loaded with Elliptical Slots
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A high gain and ultra-wide band(UWB) planar printed Vivaldi antenna loaded with elliptical slots is presented in this paper. The antenna consists of a layer of substrate and two exponentially tapered slot patches, which forms an antipodal structure. A set of symmetrical elliptical slots are loaded on the two arms of the patches, respectively. The antenna gain is increased by about 1 to 2.6dB within the frequency range of 7 to 25GHz, while the matching performance at the low frequency band is also improved. Metal vias and semi-circular slots are loaded on both sides of the microstrip feedline to improve the transmission performance at the high frequency band. According to the simulated results, the relative bandwidth of the reflection coefficient less than -10dB is 145% (6.4GHz-40GHz) with the center frequency of 23.0GHz. The simulated gain of the antenna is about 8dBi in the 6.4-17.5GHz band, and greater than 10dBi in the 17.5-40GHz band with the maximum gain of 11.3dBi. Within above band, the cross polarization is less than -15dB.

articleTitle: Millimeter Wave Microstrip Antenna Array for Automotive Collision Avoidance Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A 24GHz millimeter wave series-fed microstrip antenna array is presented in this paper. The simulation results of the proposed antenna show that the VSWR is lower than 1.5 and the gain is higher than 24dBi over the operating bandwidth from 24GHz to 24.25GHz. The power radio in both E-plane and H-plane follows the Chebyshev distribution for lower sidelobe level(SLL). The half power beamwidth(HPBW) is about 13° in the E-plane and 5.5° in the H-plane. And the SLL is lower than 16dB in the E-plane and 22dB in the H-plane, which makes it a good candidate for automotive collision avoidance radar.

articleTitle: Metasurface for Generating High-Order Millimeter Wave Orbital Angular Momentum Beams
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Electromagnetic waves carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) have found many applications. This paper discusses a metasurface plate for high-order OAM beams generation at 60 GHz. Simulation work is performed to validate the metasurface OAM generator. Mode spectrum is also obtained to quantify the quality of OAM beam, which shows that the purity of higher-order OAM beam becomes lower as the mode number increases. This study can find potential applications in high-capacity wireless communications and imaging.

articleTitle: Comparison of Two Optimization Algorithms for Focused Microwave Breast Cancer Hyperthermia
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Focused microwave hyperthermia is a promising noninvasive method for treating breast cancers by heating up the tumor while keeping the surrounding healthy tissues unperturbed. This is enabled by deploying a microwave phased antenna array around the breast and iteratively adjusting the exciting phases and amplitudes of the array elements by some optimization algorithm. Two kinds of algorithms, particle swarm optimization and differential evolution, are compared in this work by simulation work. It is shown that the latter leads to a better focusing result and uses shorter computational time.

articleTitle: Radiowave Propagation prediction in the Presence of Multiple Knife Edges using 3D Parabolic Equation Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a 3-D wide-angle parabolic wave equation (3DPE) method is applied to calculate the propagation factor over the flat terrain. A 3-D forward propagating wave is considered by using the Fourier split-step (FSS) method to march the solution along the direction of propagation. A row of perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) knife-edges with uniform height and spacing is used to calculate the lateral wave diffraction effect. A Hamming window is used to attenuate the fields smoothly at the upper boundary without reflections. The formulation of 3DPE is discussed briefly, which is followed by the FSS method and its corresponding numerical implementation. The simulation results are compared with the 2D parabolic equation 2 (DPE) model and the results presented in the literature.

articleTitle: Fast Multi-Objective Antenna Design Based on BPNN Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Aiming at reducing the large computation cost of traditional antenna design methods, a new surrogate model based on back propagation neural networks (BPNN) is constructed. In order to solve the problem of easily falling into local optimum in BPNN, a PSO-BPNN surrogate model is developed by improving initial structural parameters of neural networks and applied to fast multi-objective optimization design of multi-parameter antenna structures. Design results show that the proposed PSO-BPNN outperforms other existing antenna surrogate models in terms of prediction accuracy and prediction speed. The proposed method is of value in dealing with complex antenna designs with high-dimensional parameter space.

articleTitle: Unconventional Array for 5G Scenario: Irregular Clustering Antenna Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Current trends for mmWave (millimeter Wave) MIMO communications exploit large antenna arrays with hundreds of radiating elements, which provide highly-directive beams allowing spectral reuse through spatial diversity. Unconventional arrays are proposed for the design of base station systems for 5G applications, with the goal to simplify the required beamforming architecture with respect to standard fully-populated arrangements. This article presents an overview of some design activities, covering two different unconventional array solutions, showing implementation challenges as well as the latest achievements on this field.

articleTitle: Terahertz metasurface for flexible band-pass filter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a coupled mode theory (CMT) to design terahertz flexible band-pass filter. Based on this theory, we designed three band-pass filters with passband 0.74-0.89, 0.72-0.91 and 0.72-0.95THz. The transmission in the passband is all above 80%. This method can be easily extended to other frequency regime.

articleTitle: An ultra-wideband metasurface for RCS reduction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, split ring unit cells are proposed and designed for ultra-wideband RCS reduction. The split ring unit cell converts the incidence wave to its cross-polarization in wide bandwidth, and most importantly, the cross-polarized reflection phase and amplitude can be separately controlled by the cell geometry and rotation angle. Based on the diffuse reflection theory, reflection phase of the proposed split ring unit cells are tailored to form a ultrawide band RCS reduction metasurface. The designed metasurface demonstrate RCS reduction of 10 dB in the range of 8.75 GHz-24.7 GHz.

articleTitle: Aperiodic Planar Array Synthesis Using Pseudo-Random Sequences
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper investigates the use of pseudo-random sequences to generate non-uniform element spacing for the design of planar arrays having uniform excitations. Array factor results for the pseudo-random sequence, random, and uniform plus jitter are reported and compared. It turns out that there are tradeoffs between peak sidelobe level and minimum separation distance between elements. The Hammersley sequence reduces grating lobes while maintaining a large separation between elements.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Terahertz Stopband Filter Based on the Frequency-Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An ultra-wideband terahertz filter was investigated based on the frequency selective surface (FSS) designed by the Jerusalem cross slot structure. Through careful modeling and systematic analyzing, good stopband filtering characteristics in the range of 0.35 -0.55 THz are achieved with the transmittance <; 0.1. When the filter's bandwidth increases, our results show the FSS filter is still able to provide sound angular stability, polarization stability, and sufficient robustness.

articleTitle: Ultra-wideband All-Metal Vivaldi Phased Array Antenna With Metal Baffles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an all-metal Vivaldi antenna is designed. The metal baffles are loaded in this all-metal Vivaldi array along the H plane to eliminate the port mismatch problem when wide-angle scanning. The proposed antenna array exhibits a 4:1 (2 to 8 GHz) operating bandwidth while scanning at ±45 in the E-plane and H-plane with active VSWR <;3. The antenna is directly fed by the coaxial cable at the bottom and all-metal flared-notches consist of aluminum plates. Simulation results of the designed 8×8 array are given to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: A K/Ka Dual-band Shared-Aperture Array Design
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a shared-aperture array antenna receiving at K-band and transmitting at ka-band for satellite communication. To satisfy the wide-angle scan on both band, the space-grid is selected according to grid-lobe free condition at ka band, Patch antenna is selected as array elements on both bands, and the K-band patch is miniaturization and designed with the Ka antenna element on multi-layered materials. Full wave 3D-electromagnetic simulations are presents.

articleTitle: Novel Compact Substrate Integrated Waveguide Balun Filter and Balanced Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we present a balun filter and a balanced filter based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW). By fully utilizing the EM-field properties, only one SIW cavity is needed to realize the presented second-order balun or balanced filter. After properly arranging the locations of input/output ports in a $TE_{102}$ and $TE_{201}$ orthogonal modes SIW cavity, the desired 180° phase difference of balun or balanced filter can be obtained. Hence, filtering responses can be easy integrated to the balun or balanced circuits. The design methods of the two circuits are presented. For demonstration, a balanced filter is fabricated and measured. Good agreement between simulated and measured results verifies the proposed ideas.

articleTitle: Polarization-Insensitive Wide-Angle-Reception Metasurface for Harvesting Electromagnetic Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The paper reports a metasurface with wide-angle-reception and polarization-insensitive characteristics for harvesting electromagnetic energy. Unlike the metasurface with multiple vias, it realizes polarization-insensitive characteristics by a single via, which reduces the complexity of structure significantly. The simulation result shows that the maximum harvesting efficiency is 88% at 5.8 GHz for the arbitrary polarization at the normal incidence. On the oblique incidence of 75°, the maximum efficiency is 81% and 75% for TM and TE polarizations, respectively.

articleTitle: A Hybrid PIFA/Open-slot Antenna Array for the 3.5/4.9/5.8-GHz MIMO Operation in the Future 5G Smartphone Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, a hybrid 14-port antenna array operating in the 3.5/4.9/5.8-GHz (3300-3800/4800-5000/5725-5875 MHz) triple-band for multi-input multi-output (MIMO) operation in the 5G (fifth-generation) smartphone is presented. The proposed hybrid 14-port antenna array consists of two sub-arrays can be used for the 8×8 MIMO in 3.5/4.9 GHz band and the 6×6 MIMO in 5.8 GHz band, respectively. Simulated results show that relative impedance bandwidth of each element and array are all 15%/5%/17% or more for reflection coefficient less than -6dB (3:1 VSWR) at the center frequency of 3.5/4.9/5.8 GHz, respectively. Besides, desired gain, 3D radiation patterns, total efficiency (more than 67%) are simulated and presented. In addition, good ECC (Envelope Correlation Coefficient) of less than 0.06 for any two antenna elements and acceptable isolation (better than 11.5 dB) are also obtained.

articleTitle: An Aperture Coupled MIMO Antenna Decoupling Between Patches Using EBG Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Microstrip antenna widely used in many different devices benefit from its low profile, low gain, and narrow band characteristics. In this paper, an aperture coupled MIMO antenna is designed, and a novel EBG structure is proposed for decoupling between two patches of the MIMO antenna. Aperture coupling is a non-contact feed technology. Compared with direct contact, aperture coupled MIMO antenna has some advantages, such as simplifies the manufacturing process. EBG structure has high impedance surface to form surface wave frequency band gap, compared with other decoupling structure, the decoupling effect of EBG structure is better. Proposed EBG structure can effectively reduce the coupling between the two patches. Coupling effect between two patches of the MIMO antenna decreased 16.5dB at the operating frequency of 2.45GHz by inserting the EBG structure between the two patches.

articleTitle: Investigation on Sparse Controllable Adaptive Beamforming for Irregular Arrays
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-norm constrained normalized LMS algorithm (L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-CNLMS) is utilized to realize sparse controllable adaptive array beamforming. The L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-CNLMS algorithm exerts an l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-norm penalty on the filter coefficients of the constrained normalized LMS algorithm, aiming to put the solution towards sparsity. By introducing the l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-norm constraint, the effective elements used in the array can be effectively controlled to a certain number. Approximating l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-norm implementation method is considered to reduce the computation burden. Simulations are carried out to prove that the L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-CNLMS algorithm is valid for sparse adaptive array beamforming as well as controlling the amounts of effective antennas.

articleTitle: A new design of MEMS coplanar waveguide phase shifter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a new design of MEMS coplanar waveguide (CPW) bridge membrane to realize a small, low-loss and fewer-cell phase shifter. In the proposed structure, a symmetrical bridge membrane is added to a universal distributed MEMS phase shifter. These additional bridge membranes are placed under the CPW. By using these structure, it is possible to increase the phase shift of a unit. Furthermore, the phase shift could be increased by employing a discrete capacitance on both ends of the bridge. The structure is simulated at 10 GHz using CST software. According to simulation results for all phase states the insertion loss is 0.5 dB. The employment of the proposed structure can considerably decrease the number of cells. As a result, the size and loss can be reduced.

articleTitle: A Compact Meandered Dipole-Like Antenna for Sub-6GHz Communication Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A simple dipole-like antenna with small size has been proposed for sub-6GHz applications. The proposed antenna is fed by microstrip line, and it is realized by using a semi-circular ring patch connected with meander lines. The resonance frequency can be controlled by the dimensions of the circular ring and the length of the meander line. The performance is verified in the HFSS, and the results demonstrated that the antenna has a bandwidth of 300MHz and a good omnidirectional radiation pattern, which can be used for 4.8-5GHz sub-6GHz communication applications.

articleTitle: Field-to-Wire Coupling Model for Wire Bundles with Strongly Non-uniform Path
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a field-to-wire coupling model for wire bundles with strongly non-uniform path. Previous studies on multi-conductor transmission lines (MTL) are mainly confined to uniform or weakly non-uniform path, which is sometimes not the case in practice. In this paper, the external and internal characteristics of the wire bundle are decomposed by a mode transformation method, of which the advantage is the transformation matrices do not vary with the non-uniform path. The external characteristics correspond to common-mode (CM) components, modeled as an equivalent single wire running in the same path with the bundle above the reference ground. The internal characteristics correspond to differential-mode (DM) components, modeled as a uniform MTL system composed of the original wires in the bundle. In this way, the effects of the non-uniform path and the external field only exist in the CM model. Mode conversion caused by the dielectric coating and terminals is modeled with equivalent circuits. The proposed model is validated with a bundle of curved wires above a PCB board.

articleTitle: A Novel Tunable FSS of miniaturized unit cell for lower frequency
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Large working bandwidth is now an attractive topic for FSS design, while it's hard to acquire a FSS structure with very wide bandwidth. So the way to actively tune the response frequency of the FSS, thus giving dynamic wide bandwidth maybe an available solution to this problem. In this paper, a two-layer structure loaded with variable capacitor was proposed to adjust resonance frequency. The upper layer employs strip lines and the lower layer joins capacitors between the cross rings to tune the frequency response curves of the whole structure quantitatively. This active frequency selective surface (AFSS) is sensitive to the change of loaded capacitance in some range while stay invariably above that, in which element can be regarded as being connected. Simulation results indicates that the rationality of analysis, which provides a general method to adjust resonance frequency and guides the active design of corresponding passive FSS in return.

articleTitle: Surface-wave Transmission Analysis on Dielectric Coated Conducting Wires
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A surface-wave transmission line along with a launcher consisting of a λ/4 coaxial impedance transformer and a conical horn is designed. The surface-wave longitudinal attenuation, radial decay and phase velocity on copper wires coated with and without dielectrics are analyzed. The results could provide guidelines for the surface-wave transmission line design in the long-distance power transfer application in complex environment.

articleTitle: A GPU-Accelerated ADI Method for Transient Thermal Simulation with Parallel Cyclic Reduction
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An efficient thermal simulation approach based on Graphics Processing Units (GPU) accelerated alternating-direction-implicit (ADI) method with parallel cyclic reduction (PCR) is presented in this paper. Compared with the conventional Thomas algorithm, the PCR can accelerate the ADI method by parallel computing on GPUs. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method are illustrated by the numerical example.

articleTitle: A Magnetically Tunable Dual-mode Bandpass Filter for Cognitive Wireless System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel magnetically tunable bandpass filter for cognitive wireless system is proposed. The filter is based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) dual-mode resonator with ferrite slabs loaded near the regions of strongest magnetic field of TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">102</sub> and TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">201</sub> modes. With changing of the magnetic biasing filed, the center frequency of the filter can be tuned. The final results show that the proposed bandpass filter exhibits a tunable frequency range of about 11.27% from 11.8 to 13.13GHz with a magnetic biasing filed from 0T to 0.4T.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized Textile Tag Antenna for Wearable Passive UHF RFID Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a circularly polarized tag antenna using textile materials for wearable passive ultra high frequency (UHF) radio frequency identification (RFID) system. A corner-truncated square patch with a shorting pin and an inductive feed network are used to achieve circularly polarization and conjugate impedance matching. The antenna has similar best axial ratio values of 2.1 dB and 2.2 dB for both in air and on-body conditions, and desirable corresponding read range of 9.1 m and 8.4 m.

articleTitle: A dual band Implantable Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, a miniatured, dual band implantable antenna operating in the medical implant communications service (MICS) band (402-405 MHz) and the Industrial, Scientific and Medical service (ISM) band (2.40 - 2.48GHz) is proposed for biomedical applications. The proposed antenna has a smaller size with 10 mm × 12 mm × 1.27 mm compared to the traditional dual-band implantable antennas. The impedance bandwidths are 34.3% and 13.85% in MICS and ISM bands, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of a W-band Dual-polarization Monopulse Reflector Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper introduces a W-band dual-polarization reflector antenna which combines one dual-polarized transmit-receive SUM channel and two single-polarized DIFF receiving channels. The feed of the antenna consists of four OMTs (Orth Mode Transducer) to realize dual-polarization monopulse angle measurement. The SUM beam gain of the proposed antenna is over 41 dBi, cross-polarization level is better than -43 dB. The first sidelobe level is better than -30dB. The null-depth is better than -20dB.

articleTitle: Comparison of Human Head Phantoms with Different Complexities for Implantable Antenna Development
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Human body phantom with electrical properties is widely used in electromagnetics solvers to model the lossy human tissue environment. The selection of the phantoms affects the computational efficiency and results accuracy. In this work, we evaluated four human head phantoms with an intracranial implantable antenna. Results of phantom complexity and antenna parameters are compared to provide the reference in phantom selection for implantable antenna development.

articleTitle: A Compact, Low-Profile Dual-Band Patch Filtering Antenna for Off-Body Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A compact dual-band filtering antenna operating in the 5.0-GHz WiFi and 5.8-GHz ISM bands for wearable applications is investigated. The proposed filtering antenna is composed of a rectangular patch that etched with two pairs of rectangular slots and two notch ring slots. In addition, a set of curved parasitic patches with metallic pins are placed inside the two notch ring slots. Four rectangular slots and the curved parasitic patches generate three radiation nulls at the edges of lower and upper bands, and in the middle of the two working bands, leading to an enhanced suppression level in the stop-band. The proposed filtering antenna has the dimensions of 41.5 mm × 33.9 mm × 1.524 mm with a simulated in-band gain of about 6.5 dBi. Due to the merit radiation patterns with the front-to-back ratios of more than 15 dB, the proposed filtering antenna is suitable for the off-body communications.

articleTitle: H-Plane Horn Antenna with Slow-Wave Substrate Integrated Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A slow-wave substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) H-plane horn antenna loaded on the surface for Ka-band applications is presented in this paper. The proposed antenna is designed based on the slow-wave substrate integrated waveguide (SW-SIW) structure, which can change the field distribution in the SIW horn, and achieve good return loss, radiation pattern performance. According to the simulated results, the return loss is less than -10dB from 32.95 GHz to 34.58 GHz, and the maximum antenna gain is about 11.3 dBi. Additionally, stable symmetrical radiation pattern with low side lobe and backward radiation over the entire operation band. Therefore, the proposed horn antenna is suitable for high capacity millimeter-wave communication in the future.

articleTitle: New Circular Array Configurations for Generating Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) Beams
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a simple and feasible scheme for generating orbital angular momentum (OAM) radio beams, i.e., sequentially rotating circularly-polarized (CP) elements in a circular array. First, the principle analysis is given to illustrate the OAM generation from the proposed scheme. Then, an actual circular array design, as well as simulation results consisting of four CP elements, is presented to validate the OAM generation. Compared to the previously reported research relating to OAM generation by phased circular arrays, the main advantage of our design consists in the more simplified and flexible design of the feeding network due to the reduction of inter-element phase shifters.

articleTitle: A New Compact Quarter-Mode SIW Bandpass Filter Utilising Coaxial Cavity
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new compact bandpass filter using quarter-mode substrate integrated waveguide (QMSIW) resonators and coaxial cavity is proposed. By applying the method of quarter-mode SIW and coaxial cavity, miniaturization is achieved. As the characteristic of electromagnetic field distribution in coaxial cavity, two transmission zeros obtained by source-load coupling are utilized to improve the selectivity and out-band rejection. The SIW filter is also shown to have a good minimum rating with easing to fabricate and works at 3.95 GHz with 3dB bandwidth of 300MHz. The simulated result shows that the insertion loss (IL) of this filter is 0.8dB.

articleTitle: A Simple Differential-Fed Pattern Reconfigurable Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a differential-fed radiation pattern reconfigurable dipole antenna. The reconfigurable antenna structure consists of a pair of peanut-shape dipole with tandem double Ushape slot, a pair of parasitic elements. The antenna is excited by two differential probes through via holes, thus the size of antenna can be reduced effectively. The connected parasitic element works as a director which can realize radiation pattern reconfigurability. An impedance bandwidth of 15.6% for | S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dd</sub>| <; -10 dB is achieved with an average antenna gain of 6.5 dBi for two states.

articleTitle: A Novel Classification Method Based on Adaboost for Electromagnetic Emission Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Abundant characteristics information of equipment or systems could be obtained from electromagnetic emission data. In this paper, those characteristics of electromagnetic emission are analyzed via the adaptive boosting (Adaboost) algorithm. Based on the “basic emission waveform theory”, four types of basic fundamental elements, characteristics-harmonic, narrowband and envelope-of complex emission in frequency domain, could be extracted. For taking weights combination patterns to effectively improve the classification performance of a single classifier, high classification accuracy could be achieved by Adaboost algorithm. In our study, 100% precision classification accuracy of three types of characteristics could be obtained using Adaboost with 13 decision tree weak-classifiers. Compared with other classification methods, the Adaboost algorithm used in this paper is the most accurate. The outcomes of this research can be used as a guide in the electromagnetic compatibility design and rectification.

articleTitle: A Broadband Microstrip-Fed Patch Antenna With Harmonic Suppression
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a single-layer microstrip patch antenna with improved bandwidth and harmonic suppression. A λ/4 resonator is introduced and coupled in proximity to the feeding line for bandwidth enhancement and a spur-line is applied for high order harmonic suppression. Compared with other dual-resonance patch antennas, the proposed antenna has attractive low-profile property and simple structure. The structure, working principle, and measured results are extensively described. The operating bandwidth is from 3.42 GHz to 3.6 GHz (5.13%) with a reflection coefficient less than-10 dB, while harmonic suppression over wide frequency range from 3.6 to 8.5 GHz is achieved.

articleTitle: Ray-Launching Geometrical Optics in FEKO: A Summary of the Last Four Years of Intensive Development
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The asymptotic Ray-Launching Geometrical Optics (RL-GO) solver in FEKO has been extended enormously during the last four years, not only accelerating the solution but also reducing memory consumption and improving accuracy. Here we review the most relevant features added during the last four years and present examples to show the enhanced capabilities of the high frequency method.

articleTitle: Mutual Decoupling of Four-Element Transmit- Receive (T-R) Antenna Arrays Based on a Metamaterial Isolation Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An isolation-enhanced transmit-receive (T-R) antenna array with 2 × 2 patch elements is proposed based on metamaterial structure. Due to the resonant properties of metamaterial, the isolation structure can provide a high impedance characteristic to prevent the leakage of electromagnetic waves between the transmitting device and receiving equipment. Two columns of metamaterials are placed in the middle of the antenna array and the decoupling effect is verified by HFSS simulation. The antenna array operates at 6.19-GHz and has an isolation enhancement of about 30 dB after decoupling. The antenna can be used the radar system to enhance performance by reducing the TX-to-RX leakage.

articleTitle: 24-GHz Circularly Polarized Substrate Integrated Waveguide-Fed Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper has presented the design of a 24-GHz patch antenna with characteristics of good circular polarization, simple structure and easy fabrication. The printed antenna consists of two layers of substrates with the lower one for achieving a short-ended substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) and the upper one for supporting the rectangular radiating patch. The left-handed circularly polarized wave has been obtained by etching a 450 rotated cross-shaped slot on the broad wall of the SIW. The obtained results can confirm that the proposed antenna has achieved an impedance bandwidth (|S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>| ≤-10 dB) of 23.1-25.3GHz and the 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth of 23.2-24.7GHz.

articleTitle: Transient Electro-Thermal Analysis of On-Chip Interconnects in the Presence of ESD Pulses Using DGTD Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Transient electro-thermal simulation of on-chip interconnects in the presence of electrostatic discharge (ESD) pulses is carried out in this paper with the discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) method. The Joule heating effects of on-chip interconnects are considered in the modeling. To solve the thermal conduction equation by the DGTD method, the heat flux is introduced to construct an auxiliary differential equation (ADE). The accuracy of the proposed DGTD algorithm is demonstrated by the numerical examples.

articleTitle: An Efficient Algorithm Based on the Equivalence Principle and FDTD for Wave Propagation Prediction in Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid technique based on the equivalence principle and parallel FDTD method is proposed for predicting the field coverage of antennas in confined spaces. The first step of the method is to decompose the whole computation domain into the antenna sub-domain and the rest environment sub-domain. The field in the antenna sub-domain is computed by FDTD with fine mesh, and then the field is coupled to the environment sub-domain by using equivalence principle on the common boundary of the two sub-domains. The radiation performance and the field coverage of a Yagi-Uda antenna in a rectangular tunnel are studied by this method at the frequency band of 900 MHz (for GSM-R system). The results show that the method is suitable for field coverage prediction of confined space, especially for the tunnel environment.

articleTitle: Realization of high-gain circularly polarized planar lens antenna with beam steering capability
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents design of an integrated high-gain circularly polarized planar lens antenna aimed for beam steering applications at the Ku-band. The lens antenna consists of a phase gradient metasurface and a feed antenna. According to the principle of phase compensation, we can design three kinds of phase gradient metasurface with different phase distributions using the method of unit rotation. They not only achieve the functions of beam steering and polarization conversion, but also significantly improve the gain of the feed antenna. Through numerical simulation and analysis, we can see that the main beam can be deflected from the normal (or boresight) in a predictable direction. In the three different beam directions, the designed lens antennas are above 16.2 dB. The -10dB impedance bandwidth is approximately 950MHz and the axial ratio (AR) remains below 2 dB at 13GHz. The proposed lens antenna has the advantages of low cost, flatness and easy operation, so it has great potential in radar and wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Fast Synthesis Algorithm for Uniformly Spaced Circular Array with Low Sidelobe Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a highly efficient approach is proposed to synthesize the low sidelobe pattern of uniformly spaced circular array. The proposed approach can be generalized to deal with the pattern synthesis for the circular array with directional elements. Numerical examples are given to verify the effectiveness and advantage of this approach.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Antenna accross Microwave and Millimeter-wave Frequency Bands
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The coexistence of the microwave and millimeter-wave technologies becomes the inexorable trend of future wireless communication systems. The corresponding components of the system are required to cover these two frequency bands simultaneously, especially for the antenna. Therefore, a dual-band antenna with large frequency ratio is proposed in this paper for microwave application and millimeter-wave application simultaneously. By using the aperture coupling feeding mechanism, the SIW-based cross slot antenna and the annular ring antenna can be combined easily without deteriorate their own properties. The simulated results shows that the proposed antenna can provide linear polarization in the microwave band (5.8 GHz) and circular polarization in the millimeter-wave band (30 GHz) simultaneously.

articleTitle: A Wideband SISL U-Slot Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A wideband eight element U-slot antenna array based on substrate integrated suspended line (SISL) platform is proposed in this paper. The coupled feeding and U-slot is utilized in the antenna design. Both the proposed SISL antenna element and the antenna array are implemented by using standard printed circuit board (PCB) process. The measured results show that the operating frequency of the proposed SISL U-slot antenna array is from 22.2 GHz to 28 GHz, and the gain of 14.5 dBi is obtained at 24.45 GHz.

articleTitle: Dual-band Branch Line Coupler with High Isolation Isolation Using Loaded Coupled Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel dual-band branch line coupler with high power division isolation using coupled lines is proposed. A conventional coupler loaded with quarter-wavelength open coupled lines is adopted to realize the dual bands. Each band has a high isolation due to the introduced transmission zeros. The center frequencies of the planar coupler can be adjusted over a wide frequency band. A planar dual-band couplers located at 0.75/1.32 GHz is designed and fabricated for verification.

articleTitle: Channel Characterization for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication in Urban Sloped Terrain
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: As one of the most important modes of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), a seamless low-latency and ultra-reliable vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication network is a crucial research direction. Therefore, it is of paramount significance to characterize the V2V channels in various realistic environments, including Line-of-Sight (LOS) and Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS). In this study, we reconstruct a 3D urban environment model of a realistic block, and conduct extensive ray-tracing simulations for Tx and Rx located on vehicles travelling on the sloped terrains. Based on the results, the path loss, shadow fading, and delay spread of the channel for each case are characterized, which guide the design and deployment of V2V communication systems.

articleTitle: Broadband Tunable Metamaterial Absorber with Active Lumped Diodes
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a novel and practical way to realize broadband tunable microwave metamaterial absorber by utilizing the resistance properties of active PIN diodes. The proposed metamaterial absorber consists of metallic square-ring unit cell loaded with four identical PIN diodes, of which the resistance value can be adjusted from nearly conductor to several hundred Ohm, thus leading to a continuous tunability of the reflection rate by tuning the bias voltage on the PIN diodes. Simulation results show that the fractional bandwidth of 85.6% with at least 10 dB reflectivity reduction can be realized from 2.11 GHz to 5.26 GHz when the resistance of diodes is tuned to 315 Ω.

articleTitle: Microwave Rectifier with Wide Input Power Range Based on Resistance/Impedance Compression Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a differential resistance compression network (RCN) is proposed. It can be used to realize a differential rectifier with wide input power range, which suitable for differential rectenna application. In addition, novel single-band and dual-band complex impedance compression networks (ICNs) are proposed and applied to rectifier design. The proposed differential RCN and complex ICNs can be used to reduce the variation ranges of the rectifier’s input impedance, which change with the input power level. Thus, the loss due to the impedance mismatch is reduced, and high conversion efficiency can be obtained over wider input power ranges. For validation and comparison, the differential RCN-based, the ICN-based rectifiers and their counterparts are implemented and measured. The experimental results have validated the proposed idea.

articleTitle: Differential-mode Modeling of Common Mode Chokes for EMI filter in Switching Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposed a high frequency modeling method of common mode chokes for EMI filter in differential mode. The method consists of two parts: components modeling by impedance measurement and near field coupling effects analyzed by electromagnetic simulation calculation. Finally, the accuracy of model could be verified by the comparison between simulated and measured curves of S parameters. This modeling method could be used to predict and improve the filtration performance of EMI filter in switching power supply.

articleTitle: Mode-Selective Corrugated Substrate Integrated Waveguide: A New SIW Transmission Line : Design a new mode-selective transmission line
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new kind of corrugated substrate integrated waveguide named Mode-selective Corrugated Substrate Integrated Waveguide(MSCSIW) is presented. Due to the two arrays of stubs, this kind of transmission line could be integrated with active devices well. And the additional two slots on top surface help the transmission line acquire the new mode-selective feature. The propagation characteristics are simulated from 10GHz to 21GHz, the simulation results show that the insert loss is about -0.8 dB and the result of return loss is less than -15dB. This kind of transmission line is presented for the first time.

articleTitle: Compact Ultra-Wideband Antenna with Dual-Band Notch Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-band notched compact UWB antenna fed by CPW is presented. It is printed on FR4 substrate with a compact size of 20mm*29.5mm*1.5mm. It is designed to cover the band from 2.883 GHz to 20 GHz. This antenna is able to reduce the interference at IEEE 802.16 WiMAX (3.3-3.8GHz) band and IEEE 802.11 WLAN (5.15-5.825GHz) band, whose two frequency notches are realized by embedding split ring resonator (SRR) in the coplanar waveguides and an inverted U-shaped slot on the antenna. It has an omnidirectional radiation pattern and the gain is suppressed well at the two notched bands. This proposed work has wider bandwidth and good band rejection performance in comparison with the state of arts.

articleTitle: Miniature Microstrip Slot loaded Patch Antennas with Polycrystalline Silicon Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the integration of miniaturized patch antenna with different configurations of the solar cell is investigated. We used slot loaded microstrip patch with a solar cell to reduce the size of the patch antenna and decrease the shading effect.

articleTitle: Monitoring Diaper Condition Using the Impedance Variation of a Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To prevent skin rashes and skin eruption in babies, timely detection of urine and feces on a diaper is important. Currently, several smart diaper systems are being developed as a means of sensing excretion and alerting the caretaker to change the diaper. We propose to use the input impedance variation of a single on-diaper antenna to sense the urine and feces of a baby. By using an antenna as a sensor, there is no need to use other sensors, although an RF transmitter is necessary by default. We will locate a microstrip dipole patch antenna at the bottom of a diaper. The antenna is designed to resonate at 5.7 GHz. It senses urine and feces, for which we rely on the change to input impedance of an on-diaper antenna that results when a baby excretes urine or feces. The diaper is modeled with three layers, and the EM simulation is performed by FEKO. We observe the antenna impedance change with diverse diaper conditions and compare the results.

articleTitle: Multi-Frequency Broadband Terahertz Metamaterial Absorber Based on Graphene
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-frequency broadband terahertz metamaterial absorber based on graphene is proposed. Taking advantage of the patterned graphene on substrates with a gold reflector, it achieves two broad absorbing bands ranging from 0. 3-0.75 THz and 1.57-1.87 THz. The chemical potential of graphene is regulated by chemical doping. Besides, the absorption is sensitive to the change of incident angle at several frequency points so that it can be used in the research of angle sensor.

articleTitle: Overview of Recent MLFMM Improvements in FEKO
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The MLFMM in FEKO is continuously being extended and improved to obtain faster solution times using the minimum amount of memory. In this paper we present the memory savings obtained for parallel runs on clusters using the latest MPI-3 shared memory features, as well as a new tailored preconditioner to stabilise the iterative solution of the MLFMM.

articleTitle: Advances in Sidelobe Cancellation Including Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An interference cancellation algorithm with main-lobe maintenance is presented under the framework of generalized sidelobe canceller. The preservation of the pattern mainlobe is obtained by the mainlobe subspace. The mainlobe subspace assumed for the main beam is modified by the embedded element patterns using fast full wave simulation techniques. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the sidelobe canceller.

articleTitle: Design of a High-Performance Radome for Satellite Communication Phased Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A high-performance radome applicable for satellite communication phased array antenna is proposed in this paper. The proposed antenna radome has an ultralow profile and a symmetric aerodynamic structure, which satisfies the demand of low air resistance for bidirectional high-speed carrier. Based on the beam-scanning requirement of the adopted phased array antenna, a sandwich radome structure with variable thickness of the core layer is designed for the realization of high transmission rate at large incident angles. An engineering prototype at Ku satellite communication band was co-designed, manufactured and measured. Over the 2.5GHz operating bandwidth from 10.5GHz to 13.0GHz, the measured transmission rate was maintained above 80% through an incident angle range of 0∼ 70°.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultra-Wideband Array with Low Profile Log-Periodic Monopoles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A low profile end-fire radiation and vertical polarization log-periodic array covering an ultra-wide band of 1-10.7GHz was presented in this paper. It consists of 22 monopole elements, some of it loaded with top hats in different size to achieve the required resonant frequency, shorting posts to maintain a good impedance match in low band. A folded microstrip line on the bottom is used to feed the array. The proposed antenna has a very low profile of 0.053λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> and extremely narrow width of 0.061λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub>, (λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> is the free-space wavelength at the lowest operating frequency). Simulation results show that from 1-10.7 GHz (10.7:1) for VSWR<;2.5 and a realized gain better than 5.1dBi is obtained.

articleTitle: Fast Characteristic Mode Analysis for Half-space Platform Antennas with Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: For platform integrated antennas, the effects of the platform on the antenna performance need to be considered in their simulations for better accuracy. In this letter, the half-space multilevel fast multipole method (MLFMA) is incorporated into characteristic mode analysis (CMA) technique for platform-integrated antennas. Numerical studies verify the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed approach, and this approach provides a candidate for the platform antenna design, synthesis, and integration in the coming 5G era.

articleTitle: Wide band flexible terahertz metasurface wave plate
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Terahertz(THz) waves have important applications in security detection, biomedicine, material detection and other fields, but available devices have low efficiency and narrow frequency bands. In this paper, we present a design of high-efficiency wide band flexible reflective metasurface THz wave plates, and fabricate it through Wiener processing.

articleTitle: A Planar Structure for Eddy Current Non-Destructive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A planar structure with a lumped capacitor for eddy current non-destruction evaluation (NDE) is investigated in this paper. Compared with traditional NDE technique using coils, our proposed structure is planar and can be able to form a uniform magnetic field on the surface. The working frequency is 100 kHz and a lumped capacitor is used for optimizing the magnetic field above the plate. When a metal plate is placed in this kind of magnetic field, the eddy current will be induced on the surface of the metal. If a metal plate scratched is placed in the same field, different eddy current will be induced and the port impedance of the structure will be modified. Simulation results show the amplitude of the port current for different metal plates.

articleTitle: Design of Shaped Multibeam Reflector Antenna Based on Cognitive Behavior Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To match the far field pattern to the service area and get high gain, single offset reflector antenna is applied in this paper. Zernike polynomial is used to fit the geometry of reflector. The coefficients of Zernike polynomial are optimized by cognitive behavior optimization algorithm. A reflector antenna working at two frequency bands: 10.95~11.7GHz and 14~14.25GHz is designed. The results revealed that cognitive behavior optimization algorithm is an efficient optimization algorithm in optimizing reflector antenna.

articleTitle: Smart Glasses Radiation Effects on a Human Head Model at Wi-Fi and 5G Cellular Frequencies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Specific absorption rate and temperature rise distributions in a human head due to electromagnetic energy produced by an adjacent antenna integrated into a smart glasses are evaluated. These distributions are calculated with the use of a dispersive algorithm at 2.4 and 4.9 GHz in a single simulation. This algorithm is based on integrating the Debye model of human head tissues parameters into the finite-difference time-domain method by using the auxiliary differential equation approach and then calculating the SAR and temperature rise distributions in the head with the use of bioheat equation.

articleTitle: A Microstrip Leaky-Wave Antenna with Two Identical Stubs Per Unit Cell for Open Stopband Suppression
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A microstrip leaky-wave antenna with the open stopband suppressed is investigated. The suppression of the open stopband is achieved with two identical stubs per unit cell. Previously, it was found that the open stopband usually could not be completely suppressed if a microstrip unit cell contains two identical stubs. In this paper, it is found that the open stopband can be completely suppressed for the periodic structure, if the length of the two stubs and the distance between them can be proper designed. Based on this investigation, a microstrip periodic leaky-wave antenna with the open stopband suppressed is designed. The simulated results are shown to verify the proposed theory.

articleTitle: An Ultra Wideband Absorber With Multilayer Superstrate Based On Tightly Coupled Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An ultra-wideband absorber employing a resistive surface based on tightly coupled array (TCA),which covers whole P band, is proposed. The resistive surface is a layer of Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) coated on polystyrene. Based on the simulation with Matlab and Ansoft HFSS, the reflection coefficient and bandwidth of the absorber are given. The proposed absorber, with a thickness of only $0.1~\lambda $ at the lowest frequency, exhibits good absorption rate below -10 dB over the bandwidth of 225 MHz- 1.45 GHz.

articleTitle: Estimation of the parameters of Cold Unmagnetized Plasma Media Based on Time-Domain Inverse Scattering Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a time-domain inverse scattering technique for estimating the resonance frequency of 2-D cold un magnetized plasma scatters is proposed. The resonance frequency properties of the unknown plasma region are estimated by post processing scattering-field measurements, which are obtained when the domain of reconstructing region is illuminated by time harmonic source. The plasma scatters parameters are reconstructed by applying a global optimization technique, which combines the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method and the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. During the inversion, the resonance frequency parameters of the unknown region are expanded by a cosine Fourier series. The numerical results illuminate that the proposed method with well reconstruction accuracy and anti ill-posedness characteristics.

articleTitle: Design of Defective Electromagnetic Band-gap Structures for Use in Dual-band Patch Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Generally, the surface wave of an antenna can be suppressed by integrating the electromagnetic band-gap (EBG) structures. However, to achieve this effect, the EBG cells must be reasonably designed, otherwise it may lead to performance degradation instead. In this paper, a dual-band pinwheel-shaped slot EBG structure is proposed.When applied to a patch antenna, defects are introduced into three rows of the EBG unit cells. The proposed antenna, incorporating EBGs designed with structural defects, to radiate at 4.9 and 5.4 GHz is simulated and tested. The measured results show that the -10 -dB bandwidth of the proposed EBG antenna is extended by 41% and 25.4% at low frequency and high frequency, respectively. In addition, the peak gain of the proposed EBG antenna is increased by 2.44 dB at 4.9 GHz and 2.86 dB at 5.4 GHz with $\gt40$% efficiency. Compared with the periodic EBG antenna, this antenna is more effective.

articleTitle: Multilayer compact dual-band branch-line coupler using coupled line and open-ended stub for mobile phone application : (Invited Paper)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A compact dual-band branch-line coupler for the application of mobile phones has been proposed using multilayer PCB technology. The coupler contains six miniaturization units and two extra transmission lines (TLs). The miniaturization unit is introduced to replace the $\lambda /4$ TL for size reducing. For further miniaturization, the overall structure of the coupler uses multi-Iayer technique. The proposed coupler has high isolation and flexible frequency ratio. A coupler operating at 2.4/3.5 GHz is designed for verification. The size of the BLC is about $0.025\,\lambda _{g^{2}},$ reduced by 92% compared with the conventional hybrid.

articleTitle: Design of Broadband Dual-Polarization H-Shaped Slots Apertures-coupled Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper designs a new type of wideband microstrip dual-polarized antenna based on the H-shaped slot aperture-coupled feed technology and two-line feed technology. The antenna uses a multi-layered antenna element, and a parasitic element is added in the upper patch element to achieve broadband characteristics. The H shaped coupling slot of the antenna element is placed vertically to increase the isolation of the two feed terminals. The simulated results indicate that the antenna unit operates in the frequency range of 11.09-12.61 GHz. The gain at the center frequency is 8.47 dB. When the return loss than -10 dB, the relative impedance bandwidth is 12.9%. The isolation of the polarization ports is above 38 dB.

articleTitle: The Influence of Non-uniform Flow Field Characteristics of Hypersonic Vehicle on Electromagnetic Wave Propagation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, the ADE-FDTD algorithm was adopted to analyze the influence of plasma layer on the propagation characteristics of electromagnetic wave based on the non-uniform flow field characteristics of hypersonic vehicle. The simulation and analysis of electromagnetic wave absorption characteristics was performed with different altitude, velocity and attack angle. This study provides a theoretical basis for ground communication and the stealth of aircraft.

articleTitle: A Novel Microwave Imaging Algorithm for Solving the Inverse Scattering Problems with Inhomogeneous Background
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a solution for solving the electromagnetic inverse scattering problems (ISPs) is proposed to reconstruct the unknown targets embedded in an inhomogeneous background medium. We treat inhomogeneous background bounded in a finite domain as a known scatterer, which has the advantage of avoiding the time-consuming calculation of inhomogeneous background Green's function. Under this scheme, a new approach based on difference integral equation model, i.e., difference Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation (D-LSIE), with Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm is proposed and the generalized cross-validation (GCV) regularization technique is used to solve the inhomogeneous ISPs. The synthetic tests illustrate the efficacy of the new inversion method.

articleTitle: A Novel Method to Classify Subsurface Targets Based on DE-LM Joint Inversion Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We have developed a novel subsurface targets classification method based on the DE-LM (Differential Evolution-Levenberg Marquardt) joint inversion technique, which requires few control variables and has strong robustness. It eliminates the inaccuracy of the inversion results when an initial value is far away from the truth value by the LM, and reinforces the weak local search capability of the DE inversion technique. Next, the classification method proposed herein extracts subsurface characteristics of targets and classifies the targets automatically by means of the intrinsic responses of three-dimensional orthogonal magnetic dipole instead of using complex machine learning techniques or setting up the targets library for comparison. The experimental results show that the addition of 15% Gaussian white noise to the synthetic data can still lead to convergence to an optimal solution and classify the subsurface targets quickly and accurately, it demonstrates the effectiveness of the method proposed herein.

Author Keywords: The intrinsic responses of three-dimensional orthogonal magnetic dipole

articleTitle: Synthesis of Rotated Sparse Linear Dipole Array with Shaped Power Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new shaped pattern synthesis method is presented in which element rotations, positions and phases are co-optimized to produce a shaped beam pattern for a sparse dipole array. Compared with conventional shaped pattern synthesis using excitation amplitude and phase optimization, the proposed method can not only reduce the number of elements But also avoid the usage of unequal power dividers. A synthesis example is provided to verify the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Complementary Dielectric Resonator Antenna with Uniform Hemispherical Radiation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A slot-fed rectangular dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) with a small ground plane is investigated. By combining the radiation patterns of different resonant modes, a uniform hemispherical radiation pattern can be obtained without requiring any other element. The difference between the maximum and minimum gains is less than 3 dB in the upper half space, and moreover, the front to back ratio is as high as 30 dB.

articleTitle: In-Band RCS Reduction of Microstrip Patch Array Antenna Using Polarization Reconfigurable Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The approach of switchable polarization can provide a random polarization (RP) distribution, which will implement in-band radar cross section (RCS) reduction of a microstrip patch array antenna. The proposed antenna has a simple structure with two L-shaped slots on the patch, consisting only two PIN diodes to produce linear polarization(LP), left- and right-hand circular polarization(LHCP /RHCP). To illustrate the availability of the mentioned method, a 7×7 polarization reconfigurable microstrip array, which contains 4 polarization modes, is compared and analyzed. From the results, the RCS of RP mode array can be reduced by more than 6dB without affecting radiation performance.

articleTitle: A Dual-mode SIW Filter with Tunable Frequency, Reconfigurable Bandwidth and Adjustable Transmission Zero
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a dual-mode SIW filter with tunable frequency, reconfigurable bandwidth and adjustable transmission zero. Two copper posts are loaded in two diagonal positions of a square-shaped SIW resonator, five surface-side ring-shaped slot resonators and corresponding tuning elements are respectively placed in the proper positions where the electric field strength of diagonal TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</inf>, diagonal TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">201</inf>, and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">102</inf> modes is the largest. By changing the capacitance values of the five tuning elements, it is possible to realize not only frequency tuning, but also bandwidth reconfiguration and transmission zero adjustment. Simulation results show that the presented filter exhibits a tuning range from 3.03 GHz to 3.78 GHz with insertion loss variation of 0.75–1.6dB and a BW range of 40–80 MHz around 3.75 GHz.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Vector Wave Equation- and Maxwell’s Equation-Based Discontinuous Galerkin Time Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A hybrid scheme composed of vector wave equation-based discontinuous Galerkin time domain method (DGTD-WE) and Maxwell’s equation-based discontinuous Galerkin time domain method (DGTD-ME) has been proposed to solve the electromagnetic problems. An upwind flux scheme is developed to hybridize the DGTD-WE and DGTD-ME. Numerical results demonstrate good performance of the proposed hybrid algorithm.

Author Keywords: vector wave equation-based discontinuous Galerkin time domain method (DGTD-WE)
Maxwell’s equation-based discontinuous Galerkin time domain method (DGTD-ME)

articleTitle: Flexible Antenna for Wearable Devices at Wi-Fi frequency band
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a structure for the patch antenna to make it more flexible for biomedical applications. In this structure, the electrical length of the antenna will not change by bending the antenna, and therefore the resonance frequency will not vary.

articleTitle: Application of Maehly Approximation to EM scattering from a Dielectric Rough Surface and a Dielectric object over a Frequency Band
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient method, which is based on Chebyshev series and Maehly approximation, is proposed to fast simulate the EM scattering from a dielectric rough surface and a dielectric object over a frequency band. Results of the Maehly approximation and the exact results obtained by the method of moments (MoM) have achieved a good agreement both in horizontal and vertical polarization. Moreover, the present work indicates that the Maehly approximation improves computational efficiency.

articleTitle: FDTD Solver with Time-Domain Perturbation Method for Simulating An All-Optical Switch Realized by Nonlinear Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Recent advances in metasurfaces enable great opportunities to achieve novel nonlinear devices in photonics, like all-optical switches. Simulating a nonlinear metasurface, however, is still a quite challenging task. In this paper, we develop a finite difference time domain algorithm with time-domain perturbation method to solve this problem. The proposed algorithm shows elegant physical insights for the nonlinearities of metasurfaces, and it has great performances on efficiently calculating nonlinear equations in numerical ways. An all-optical switch realized by a specific nonlinear metasurface is simulated, and intriguing switching properties are clearly observed in the responses of the nonlinear metasurface.

articleTitle: Metasurface for controlling the reflection and transmission wavefront independently
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new metasurface which can achieve a continuous phase range more than 360° for reflection and transmission simultaneously is proposed. At the frequency band of interest, both the amplitude of reflection and transmission is greater than 0.7. The metasurface can be applied to reflection or transmission planar focus lens, orbital angular momentum vortex wave generating, reducing radar cross section (RCS) and can access to multiple functions according to different required phase combination.

articleTitle: The Combination of Generalized Single-Source TEPA and Contact-Region Modeling for Solving Array Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the generalized single-source tangential equivalence principle algorithm (GSST-EPA) is combined with contact-region modeling (CRM) to solve the electromagnetic scattering of array structures. The CRM is used to decompose the array structures into subdomains with the same size. Then each subdomain is enclosed by the same equivalence surface. The GSST-EPA can be used to transfer the unknowns of subdomains onto the equivalence surfaces, which can reduce the number of unknowns and improve the conditioning of final matrix. The numerical results are given to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Transmission-Line/SAW BPF using transversal signal-interaction concepts
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a method of increasing the band-width of a narrowband frequency selection circuit of a surface-acoustic-wave (SAW) RF band-pass filter (BPF) by using signal-interference technique is proposed. The bandwidth is increased by inserting SAW narrow-band BPF into the transversal filtering section (TFS) of the signal jamming filter while cascading two different transversal filters to increase bandwidth and filter selectivity. For practical verification, the circuit with a 916MHz commercial SAW filter chip shows a passband-width 8 times wider than the width of the embedded on-chip SAW BPF.

articleTitle: High-gain Wideband Fabry-Perot Resonator Antenna Based on Single-layer FSS Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband Fabry-Perot (FP) resonator antenna is designed based on single-layer frequency selective surface (FSS) structure. The antenna adopts a single-layer complementary circular FSS structure as the partially reflecting surface (PRS) of FP resonator antenna to improve the gain of antenna. The proposed PRS maintains a positive slope reflection phase gradient in the 10.3-16 GHz band. The simulated results show that the operating band of the proposed antenna covers 11.99-15.81 GHz, the relative bandwidth is 27.5%, the maximum gain is 13.26 dBi at 14.4 GHz, and the 3-dB gain bandwidth is 26.3%.

articleTitle: Cascaded TSS-FDTD for Analyzing Underwater Low-Frequency Electromagnetic Propagation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A cascaded total-field scattered-field source finite-difference time-domain (TSS-FDTD) method is used to analyze the underwater propagation properties of a low-frequency electromagnetic wave. In order to obtain the long-distance electromagnetic fields, two or more steps FDTD calculations are included. The relationship between two times FDTD calculations is the field data exchange on the TSS boundary. The grid ratio of two times calculation spaces can be set to an arbitrary positive odd integer, for instance N=5. The numerical results verify the accuracy and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: RCS Calculation of Dynamic Target
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for solving the radar cross section of dynamic target with partial modification. In this method, the angle conversion algorithm solves the incident angle firstly and then the partial modification algorithm reduces the computational complexity, achieves rapid calculation of dynamic target. Numerical results prove the efficiency and accuracy of the method.

articleTitle: Simulation of All-dielectric Metasurfaces with Finite Thickness Based on FDTD-GSTC
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We propose an effective simulation method of Finite Difference Time Domain-Generalized Sheet Transition Conditions (FDTD-GSTC) for electromagnetic fields from all dielectric metasurfaces with finite thickness. The susceptibilities are introduced in place of physical metasurfaces, which can be calculated from reflection or transmission coefficients with periodic boundary conditions. The standard FDTD-GSTC is only employed for metasurface with zero thickness, in this work, for a metasurface with finite thickness, we characterize it by splitting into several sheets with approximately zero thickness. The continue conditions are enforced between adjacent sheets. Numerical simulation results of the all dielectric metasurface validate the accuracy of the improved method.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Circularly Polarized Yagi Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A miniaturized circularly polarized (CP) Yagi antenna is proposed based on bowtie antenna array for satellite communication. The antenna is composed of six director elements, a driven element and a reflector element. The driven element consists of a pair of orthogonal bowtie antennas operating at 440 MHz, fed by an out-of-phase power splitter and 90 degree phase shifters to achieve circularly polarized radiation. Simulated results show that the antenna has a good CP performance over the frequency band from 435 to 445 MHz, with an axial ratio of 0.73 dB and a gain of 11 dBi at 440 MHz. The overall size of the antenna is 171×171×1105 mm3, the transverse size of the antenna is only about λ0/4 × λ0/4.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Failed Arrays Pattern Recovery based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In large antenna arrays, the failure of some radiation elements is inevitable. In this case, the pattern is usually destroyed and the performance of array is mostly decreasing. In this paper, genetic algorithm is used to improve the similarity of the antenna pattern by optimizing the weight of the working array elements. When there are some interference signals, it can better recover the null. At the same time, the correlation coefficient can represent the similarity of two arrays. The mean of error can explain the error of the two array patterns, so the two numerical results can be used to evaluate the effect of optimization, and to illustrate the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A Flush-mounted Ultra-wideband Scanning Phased Array with End-fire Radiation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A low-profile, ultra-wideband (UWB), end-fire scanning phased array is proposed in this paper. The array consists of four log-periodic monopole array antennas (LPMAs) and is flush-mounted in a shallow cavity to further reduce the array height.
