Simulated results show an operating frequency band from 1.0 to 3.0 GHz and end-fire radiation patterns with ±45° scanning performance in horizontal planes, demonstrating that the proposed end-fire array is suitable for low-profile, conformal applications with satisfactory scanning performance.

articleTitle: The FDTD-based Time-Reversal Method for Diagnosis of Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Array element failure is one of the challenges in application of antenna arrays. The existing methods are of frequency-domain, and they can be complicate, expensive or time consuming. In this paper, we propose the use of the time-reversal method for array diagnosis. The method can directly reconstruct both operating and defect elements without matrix operations. Both theoretical analysis of the time-reversal method and computation of an example are presented to verify the effectiveness of the time-reversal method.

articleTitle: Fast Computation of Monostatic RCS of Objects by Combing Characteristic Basis Function Method and Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A hybrid approach is proposed for fast computation of monostatic radar cross section (RCS) of objects. The proposed method applies the singular value decomposition (SVD) to compress the excitation matrix and introduces a new method to construct the characteristic basis functions (CBFs) considering the mutual interaction among blocks. Under such circumstances, the number of matrix equation solutions and the number of CBFs are both significantly reduced. Numerical examples verify and demonstrate that the proposed method is credible both in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Shape Optimization Design of Multi-beam Reflector Antenna based on Multi-objective Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm(MOPSO) is used to optimize the design of the multi-beam biased reflector. In the process of optimization, the z coordinate of the NURBS surface control point which represents the shape of the reflectance surface is taken as the optimization parameter, the physical optical(P0) method is used to calculate the far field, and the gain of different beam is optimized. Improved the gain and Carrier interference ratio(C/I)characteristics of the whole large coverage area. Finally, a practical example is given to verify the effectiveness of this algorithm in engineering application.

articleTitle: Design of wideband and dual-polarized antenna array with 3D-printing method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a wideband and dual-polarized antenna array. The cross dipole is used as the basic antenna element and the air-filled strip line is used as the transmission line of the feeding network. The total metal structure is adopted to achieve high efficiency of the antenna array. Because lots of air filled components and total metal structure are used in the antenna array, the metal supports for structures should be designed carefully. A 4 x 4 array is designed for verifying this method. The simulated show that the proposed wave antennas can cover the bandwidth of 10.5-14.5 GHz (32% relative bandwidth) with VSWR<;2.2. The realized gain varies from 18.2 dB to 20.4 dB over the frequency band. The total height of the antenna array part is only 11.5mm. Due to the complicated structure, this antenna will be fabricated with metal 3D Printing techniques.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Ship RCS Reduction Based On Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Applying radar absorbing material on the surface of the ship can effectively reduce the radar cross section of the ship, thereby reducing the possibility of the ship being detected by the radar. In this paper, the ship's electromagnetic model is taken as the research object, and a genetic algorithm is used to optimize the RCS (Radar Cross Section) of the ship.

articleTitle: The Estimation of Rotors Parameters Based on Micro-Doppler Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A large number of weapons targets contain rotating structures in modern warfare. These rotating parts have a huge impact on their radar scattering characteristics. Since the velocity of the rotating parts differs from that of weapon, its electromagnetic scattering characteristics usually contains Doppler phenomenon, and is accompanied by Doppler frequency shift. In this paper, taking the helicopter rotor as example, the parameters of rotor target such as the number, size and rotation speed of the rotors are discussed through the RCS time-frequency spectrum.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Microwave Detection System Based on DFB Laser Diode
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel microwave detection system based on DFB laser diode is designed in this paper. Practical test results show that the dynamic range of the detection system achieves greater than 10 dB in the 2 to 6 GHz frequency range, and the response time is less than 3 ns. To compare with traditional electric output detectors, the detection system employs a DFB laser diode as a tube core, and which can directly output demodulated optical signals through fibers. Therefore, it possesses great applicable prospects in utilizing as a field monitor for high-power microwave (HPM) applications where anti-interference, long-distance transmission without distortion is desired.

articleTitle: Novel Beam Scanning Antenna System Fed by Reconfigurable Beamforming Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel beam scanning antenna system is presented. The antenna includes 11 units, which cover the range of 90° in the azimuth fed by a reconfigurable beamforming network. And the beamforming network is cascaded by one two-stage Wilkinson power divider, four 1-bit phase shifters and four single-pole three-throw (SP3T) switches. The phase shifters and switches are digitally controlled by PIN diodes. The beam direction of the antenna is switched among 8 cases with each covering 11.25°, further constituting a whole range of 90°.

articleTitle: The Design and Analysis of a Static and Extremely Low-Frequency Magnetic Field Stimulation Platform for Cell Prolifation Inhibition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: It is known that tumor cells can be influenced by extremely low-frequency magnetic field stimulation. However, the optimal field strength and frequency have not yet been fully determined. In this paper, a static and extremely low-frequency magnetic field stimulation system with adjustable frequency and magnetic flux density was proposed. Additionally, a new planar stimulation coil with a printed circuit board is proposed which cooperates with the system. The field distribution of the stimulation system was simulated by numerical computation and the principle of the system was also analyzed. It was shown that the proposed stimulation system with coils could induce a wide range of extremely low-frequency magnetic fields and could accelerate the optimization process of field parameters.

articleTitle: Meta or select?: —history, argument and prospective about MTMs and FSS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the development history of metamaterials (MTMs) and Frequency selective surfaces (FSS) was sketched, and the two conception was discussed. Furthermore, state of the art of both terms was introduced and the prospective was predicted, and the idea of electromagnetic lattice was proposed.

articleTitle: Study on Wearable Antenna Arrangement for Intelligent Healthcare Management
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this study, the wearable antenna for intelligent healthcare management and 5G communication is investigated. An arrangement of several wearable antennas is discussed at 4.8 GHz. Simulation is completed mainly by the finite-different time domain (FDTD) method.

articleTitle: Dielectric Resonator Antenna for Wide Millimeter-Wave band
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A rectangular dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is excited by properly combine two higher-order modes, TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">113</sub> and TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">115</sub> to provide a wide 10-dB impedance bandwidth of about 25% in millimeter wave band. The variation of antenna gain is less than 1.5 dB across impedance passband (|S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>|<;-10dB).

articleTitle: Recent Developments of Terahertz Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of multimedia services, mobile traffic has exploded. The rapid development of intelligent terminal applications require wireless transmission speeds of several tens of Gbit/s. In order to be able to transmit such a high data rate, the carrier frequency needs to be increased to more than 100 GHz. This will alleviate the spectrum scarcity and capacity limitations of current wireless systems and enable new applications in the traditional network and next-generation wireless communications. This article provides an overview of terahertz communication systems and summarizes the research progress in key components.

articleTitle: Low Losses Rhomb Antenna Based on Covered Patch
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A method to reducing antenna losses is proposed by reducing current losses in the reflector elements. Two test antennas working at 76.5 GHz have been realized, tested, and compared to a standard reflectarray antenna with rectangular patches. The bandwidth of the antenna based on covered rhomb patch is 11 GHz and it performs best with respect to the loss in gain between 71 GHz and 81GHz.

articleTitle: The Combination of GPU and CPU Techniques to Fast Calculate High Frequency Scattered Fields from 3-D Realistic Scatterers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper improves the traditional GRECO method in calculating the physical optics (PO) scattered field both for triangular and quadric facet. The shadowing approach uses color-index to mark the surface element and calculate facet-based integral, instead of pixel-based integral approximation. This hybrid method has the same calculation speed as the traditional GRECO but reduces the memory usage. We test the method in calculating the complex target glider.

articleTitle: 4 x 1 Substrate Integrated Dielectric Resonator Antenna Array for Ka-band Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A 4 x 1 substrate integrated dielectric resonator antenna array (SIDRAA) is presented for Ka-band application, in which the substrate integrated dielectric resonator antenna (SIDRA) elements and the feeding structure can be codesigned using a two-layer printed circuit board (PCB) process. Four SIDRAs are designed in the Rogers RT6010 substrate using the perforation technique and fed by a compact substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) through four longitudinal coupling slots within the Rogers RT5880 substrate. The return loss, radiation patterns, and antenna gain were studied. The SIDRAA provides a bandwidth of about 10% around 34.5 GHz for 10 dB return loss and stable broadside radiation patterns with the simulated gain of11.2 -12.5dBi across the band.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band, Highly Selective Bandpass Frequency Selective Surface Using Coupling Resonance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A highly selective dual-band bandpass frequency-selective surface (FSS) is proposed by using coupled resonance, which consisted of 3-layer double hexagonal loops (DHLs). The FSS shows stable incident angles response with polarization insensitive.

articleTitle: Accelerating the Evaluation of Series Representing the 2-D Periodic Green’s Function
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The free space Green's function with 2-D periodicity usually show very slow convergence owing to unavoidable singularities in the reciprocal solution domain. Particularly, the spatial domain Green's function doesn't convergence at all when the source point is in the same domain as the observation point. A method is discussed to effectively improve the slow convergence by using the Ewald method and summing in a combination of spectral and spatial expression. Numerical results demonstrate that the transform converges rapidly than the direct original summation series.

articleTitle: Efficient Leapfrog 2-D SF FDTD Method for Periodic Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient Leapfrog implementation of the 2-D split-field (SF) FDTD method for solving problems of the oblique incident plane wave on periodic structures. By adopting the modified (SF) method, Peaceman-Rachford scheme, one-step Leapfrog scheme and Sherman-Morrison formula, the proposed (SF) method is implemented in the much simpler scheme than traditional (SF) method. Furthermore, the Courant-Friedrich-Levy (CFL) stability condition of the proposed method is weaker. The accuracy and efficiency of this method are verified by numerical results.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Cross Polarization Property of Waveguide Slot
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Cross polarization is the inherent property of waveguide slot antenna. The usual suppression measures decrease its influence, but these don't consider how to utilize this intrinsic property, for example cross polarization of mono-pulse antenna can be used for producing interference, so it is necessary to research the cross polarization property. Based on the polarization property of sidewall slot, the cross polarization principle is analyzed, and the property is simulated in different conditions. Good agreement of the theory with results, and these have great benefit to the utilization of waveguide slot antenna. This study provides an important theoretical basis for ECM and ECCM technology studies in mono-pulse tracking area.

articleTitle: On the radar performance assessment under interference environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The assessment method is presented to analyze the radar performance under the interference environment. Single pulse and multiple pulses detection models of radar are constructed to assess the performance of radar. The assessment method can apply radar performance analyses under arbitrary interference.

articleTitle: Simulation of Temperature Increase of Human Head Model Exposed to Cell Phones
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: One of the most serious consequences of electromagnetic radiation from mobile phones on human health is the increment of temperature of tissues and organs. Due to the specificity of the research object, numerical methods for electromagnetic and thermal analysis are usually adopted instead of trials. This paper utilized the finite element method for electromagnetic and thermal simulation of human head. Radiative cooling phenomenon is taken into account during the thermal simulation by using the radiation boundary condition. Numerical results validate the accuracy and capability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Approximate Flat-top Pattern for Efficient Microwave Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An approximate flat-top pattern of the transmitting antennas for efficient microwave wireless energy transmission system is presented. The flat-top pattern is fitted through the least squares method according to the basic patterns from the assigned apterture distribution of the transmitting antennas, along with high beam collection efficiency (BCE). The following aperture distribution of transmission antenna can be obtained through the weighted of basic patterns. In an Numerical case, the BCE reaches 92.20% near to the one of 10dB Gaussian aperture adistribution, the presented mthod can give more uniform power density on the receiving antenna than the aperture distributions of the uniform and 10dB Gaussian cases.

articleTitle: RCS Reduction and Axial Ratio Improvement of a Circularly Polarized Antenna by EBG Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new configuration aimed at reducing radar cross section (RCS) and improving radiation properties of circularly polarized (CP) patch antenna is proposed. The CP patch antenna is surrounded by two different orientations of artificial magnetic conductor (AMC) cells, which are of nearly 180° difference in reflection phase. Based on phase cancellation, the RCS of the antenna can be reduced. By introducing two other patch elements of the same shape with the central CP patch, the AR bandwidth can also be improved. Simulation results show that compared with reference antenna, the proposed antenna obtains a 10dB RCS reduction bandwidth for both x and y polarizations and gets a broader bandwidth of 3dB AR, which is from 9.96 GHz to 10.43 GHz (4.6%).

articleTitle: Inverse Scattering and Information Management - Trends and Envisaged Strategies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper deals with the information management in inverse scattering by means of suitable strategies. The role of a-priori, iteratively-acquired, and physical information as useful source for improving the reconstruction derived from the data processing is discussed. A review of methodologies and advances which have been recently proposed in literature is presented, along with a selected numerical results aimed at showing the potential benefits afforded by a smart use of the available information on the problem at hand.

articleTitle: Polarization-Dependent Terahertz Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, two kinds of polarization-dependent metasurfaces are proposed for wavefront manipulation. The results of the proposed polarization-dependent metasurfaces are illustrated while their operating principles are also briefly given.

articleTitle: An Arbitrary Phase-Difference Hybrid Coupler with Enhanced Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The existing arbitrary phase difference hybrid couplers usually have limited bandwidths due to the much more complex requirements for implementing non-standard phase difference. To effectively extend the bandwidth of a two section branch line coupler with arbitrary phase difference, a coupled line section is utilized to replace the middle branch. For validation, two 3 dB couplers which provide 45° and 135° phase differences were designed and fabricated. They were measured to achieve wide bandwidths of 33.7% and 25% respectively.

articleTitle: Dual-polarization ultra-thin tunable AMC surface for P/L bands applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A dual-polarization ultra-thin tunable AMC (TAMC) surface working in P/L bands is presented. The tunability is achieved by parallelly inserting varactor diodes between patch and ground plane. The working characteristic of the TAMC is theoretically analyzed by establishing equivalent circuit model. Simulated results show that the proposed TAMC has ultra-thin profile (0.0035λ) and achieves wide tunable bandwidth from 0.35 GHz to more than 2 GHz.

articleTitle: The Field-Wire Coupling Characteristics of the Twisted-Wire Pairs Illuminated by the Electromagnetic Pulse
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, the field-to-wire coupling model based on the transmission line theory is utilized to study the terminal response of the Twisted-wire pairs (TWP). The TWP irradiated by a uniform plane wave. The coupling characteristics was obtained by modifying the pitch and length of the TWP. The results show that: a) the power dissipation induced at the end decreases with the reduction of the pitch of the TWP; b) when the TWP is electrically-short at the frequency of interest, the power dissipation induced at the end increases as the length of the TWP increases; c) When the length of the TWP is an odd multiple of one-half wavelength corresponding to the frequency point, the power dissipation induced at the end has a maximum value; d) From the spectrum diagram, it can be concluded that the total length of the twisted pair only affects the frequency of the resonance and does not affect the coupling energy amplitude.

articleTitle: A Differential-fed Dual-Band Directional Antenna for WLAN and WiMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A differential-fed dual-band directional antenna is proposed for WLAN and WiMAX applications. The differential-fed dual-band directional antenna is composed of a pair of dual-band dipole. Each dual-band dipole element consists of a pair of bend arms, and an isosceles trapezoid patch for 3.5-GHz band, and a rectangle branch for 2.4-GHz band. The measured results show that two operating bands of the antenna is from 2.38 to 2.58 GHz and from 3.18 to 4.18 GHz. The obtained directional radiation patterns are stable at both frequency bands with a gain of 7.4 dBi for the low band, 8 dBi for the high band.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of surface profile from optical scattered field
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work we propose a method for reconstructing the profile of rough surfaces with superresolution from far-field scattering measurements obtained with Tomographic Diffractive Microscopy (TDM). The inversion algorithm used in the reconstruction, where the optimization is performed with TE and TM data simultaneously, does not require any regularization step and accounts for multiple scattering.

articleTitle: Bowtie dipole Wideband Endfire Antenna With Out-of-Phase Power Divider
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A wideband periodic antenna with bowtie dipoles, fed by out-of-phase power divider, is proposed. A wideband transition from two microstrip lines to a parallel stripline, and a coupling between two microstrip lines on the top and bottom substrate layers through a slot in the common ground plane are used to achieve an wideband operation. The simulations and measurements show that the antenna presents an impedance bandwidth of 100% for S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> ≤ -10dB, the average gain of 3.4dB in the endfire directional and stable endfire radiation patterns. Its total size is 43 mm x 87 mm.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Algorithm for Electromagnetic Scattering of Complex Targets
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A hybrid algorithm of MoM and PO methods is studied here. Both of these methods obtain the target scattering field by calculating the current distribution of the object surface. The difference is that the MoM obtains the surface current distribution by solving the matrix equation and is an accurate numerical method, while PO ignores the interaction between the local surface current and the shadow current. Current-based hybrid algorithms are the main methods for solving the electromagnetic scattering and radiation of the electric mesoscale and multi-scale targets. The hybrid MoM-PO algorithm can be effectively used to solve the three-dimensional electromagnetic target on complex large-scale electromagnetic platform. And it can greatly reduce the computer's memory requirements and computing time. This paper mainly studies and analyzes the efficiency and accuracy of the iterative hybrid MoM-PO algorithm.

articleTitle: Spoof surface plasmons on the dielectric-loaded doubly-corrugated grating for Terahertz applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Spoof surface plasmons (SSP) on the corrugated metal surfaces has attracted enormous attentions due to its many extraordinary properties and can find a variety of applications in microwave and terahertz (THz) community. In this paper, we present a theoretical and numerical study of SSP mode on the dielectric-loaded double-corrugated gratings. General SSP dispersion theory is developed by a simplified modal expansion method on the structure which is also verified in THz band. In our referred structure, symmetric SSP mode demonstrates lower propagation loss compared with the other anti-symmetric SSP mode. Our studies about SSP modes on the dielectric-loaded doubly corrugated grating can provide new ways to realize both extreme sub-wavelength confinement and low propagation loss. Potential applications include low loss waveguide and circuitry, sensitive sensing and novel electronic sources induced by injected electron beam, etc.

articleTitle: Multiscale Modeling of Magnetic Distribution in a Magnetic Core of High-frequency Transformer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The multiscale finite element method (MsFEM) combined with conventional finite element method (FEM) is proposed to solve static magnetic field in the ribbon magnetic core. Firstly, a simple 2-dimensional electrostatic problem is used to introduce the MsFEM part. The results are compared to analytical method, as well as conventional FEM. Then, an example of magneto static problem is considered for a ribbon magnetic core built sheet by sheet. Conventional FEM and MsFEM are used to compute the magneto-static field by adopting scalar magnetic potential. Both magnetic potential and magnetic flux density on a certain path are compared. It is shown that the results obtained by MsFEM agrees well with the one from conventional FEM. Moreover, MsFEM combined with FEM is potentially a general strategy for multiscale modeling of ribbon magnetic cores, which can effectively reduce the computational cost.

articleTitle: A super wide bandwidth CPW fed Monopole enhanced by a horizontal ground plane
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a new co-planar waveguide (CPW) fed antenna having a 26:1 super wide bandwidth because of the addition of a ground plane. The new antenna has two sets of ground planes perpendicular to each other. The simulation shows the horizontal ground improves the antenna's matching in the lower band. Due to the new ground plane configuration, the antenna works well from 2.2 GHz to over 80 GHz. The horizontal ground also helps the antenna on its front-back ratio when frequency gets high. The radiation patterns of the proposed antenna are quite stable throughout its impedance bandwidth. Because its bandwidth and radiation patterns, the antenna could be used in 5G and other millimeter wave applications.

articleTitle: A DDM With Curvilinear Discretizations for Solving Scattering from PEC Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an integral equation-based non-conformal and non-overlapping domain decomposition method (DDM) is proposed for solving electromagnetic scattering from large-scale and multi-scale perfect electric conducting (PEC) objects. In this DDM, discontinuous vector basis functions are employed to expand the surface currents flowing across adjacent sub-domains, and a novel interior penalty term is introduced to weakly enforce the normal continuity of these currents. The proposed method provides an effective domain decomposition preconditioner with no need to introduce an additional contour sub-domain or a buffer region. Moreover, no stabilization term is required in this method, making it much easier to be applied for curvilinear discretizations to obtain higher modeling accuracy. Several numerical examples are given to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Compressive Processing for Computational Electromagnetics - Theoretical Basics, Current Trends and Advances
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: antenna radiation patterns; antenna feeds; electromagnetic wave polarisation; electromagnetic wave scattering; broadband antennas; microstrip antennas; finite difference time-domain analysis; substrate integrated waveguides; UHF antennas; frequency selective surfaces.

articleTitle: Analysis of Nonlinear Capacitor LC Circuits Based on the Transfer Matrix Symplectic Conserved Perturbation Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the transfer matrix symplectic conserved perturbation method for LC circuit with nonlinear capacitor is studied. Deducing from the Coulomb volt characteristics of the nonlinear capacitance, electric charge q of the capacitor and the magnetic flux linkage φ of the inductance is treated as the state variables and the corresponding control equations are discribed in dual form. The Hamiltonian matrix is written as the combination of linear and nonlinear parts. On the basis of the analytical solution of the linear part, the problem could be considered as symplectic matrix multiplication by using canonical transformation. After obtaining the solution of the corresponding part. The characteristics of the LC circuit oscillation can be solved. The numerical results reveal that higher precision and stability could be acheived by utilizing the methed proposed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Characteristics of Airborne Dual Trailing Antenna for the Submarine Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Submarines can navigate underwater and widely used in national defense construction, underwater geological exploration and rescue operations. However, how to achieve effective communication with the submarine has become an urgent problem. According to the development of very low frequency (VLF) communication needs, the electromagnetic theory model of airborne VLF dual trailing antenna system is established. VLF dual trailing antenna radiation characteristics and simulation analysis of near-field characteristics of airborne platform are realized.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategies for Multibeam Transmitarray Antennas for 5G Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Multibeam antennas are the enabling technology for the realization of Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) architectures to be used in 5G communication systems. Here, their feasibility with a Transmitarray (TA) is investigated, and three different approaches for their design are presented. The first one is a deterministic method, aimed to design a bifocal surface, the second proposes the use of a concave TA, while the other technique is based on the use of a pseudo-stochastic optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: A Modeling Method of Moving Target’s Radar Cross Section
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In consideration of the influence of target moving, components rotarying and structure deformation on the precision of electromagnetic scattering modeling A an exact moving target's RCS modeling method based on the measured data was proposed in this paper. Firstly, using laser scanning method to build the precise geometric model of the real target; Secondly, extracting the parameters of the target motion characteristics in the actual flight, and taking the parameters to modify the model; Finally developing integration software to calculate the electromagnetic scattering and verify the result with the measured data.

articleTitle: Joint Inversion of Acoustic and Electromagnetic Data for Imaging Human Thorax
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we study a joint inversion scheme of acoustic and electromagnetic data for thorax imaging. Based on contrast source inversion method, we define contrast source and contrast function for both acoustics and electromagnetic waves. Two reciprocal regularization operators are also introduced to integrate acoustic and electromagnetic inversion. By minimizing the cost functional using nonlinear conjugate gradient method, we can simultaneously reconstruct compressibility, attenuation, permittivity, and conductivity of different human tissues. Numerical experiments show that acoustic inversion and electromagnetic inversion can compensate each other and achieve higher resolution. Furthermore, this joint inversion scheme is particularly sensitive to compressibility and conductivity, thus may be used to monitor air and water contents in human lungs.

articleTitle: Design of A Rectifier with High Efficiency and Wide Load Range
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a rectifier with wide dynamic load range based on dc-dc converter is proposed. The rectifier with shunt-diode topology consists of a T-shaped stub matching network, a rectifying diode and a dc-pass filter. A microwave-direct current (mw-dc) rectifying efficiency of 77% is measured at 5.8GHz operation frequency on the condition of 90 mW input power and 195 Ω load. A pulse width modulation (PWM) controlled buck-boost dc-dc converter is designed to expand the load range. The rectifier with dc-dc converter is fabricated and the measured result shows that the rectifying efficiency is higher than 50% when the load varies from 250 to 3000Ω.

articleTitle: A New Electrode Configuration Scheme in Electrical Impedance Tomography for Thorax Imaging
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, a new electrode configuration scheme is proposed for electrical impedance tomography applied to thorax imaging. Different from traditional configuration schemes in which all the electrodes are put on the surface of human thorax, the new scheme allocates one electrode in the esophagus. The excitation-measurement method is designed based on the new scheme, and numerical experiments are performed by inverting synthetic data generated from a two-dimensional thorax model. The results are compared with that of traditional electrode configuration. It can be concluded that better resolution of the interior thorax can be achieved using the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Design of Loop Antenna Based on Spiral Loading
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the design scheme of a spiral-loaded short-loop antenna was proposed, which keep the function of omnidirectional antenna and effectively reduced the profile height and lateral size simultaneously. Unlike dipole or monopole omnidirectional antenna technology, this solution uses a limited mounting base as the ground of the antenna, the erected ring-shaped microstrip line as the radiating part of the antenna, and, fence-type metal plates, spiral loaded, or short-circuit are used at the feed end of the microstrip line, the upper and lower ends, which improves the impedance bandwidth of the antenna in the low frequency band and enables the antenna to achieve omnidirectional communication in the H-plane. The measured results show that the relative bandwidth of the antenna impedance is 21.8%. The simulation results are in good agreement with the measured results. The antenna has a wide range of engineering applications.

articleTitle: A Ku-Band Substrate Integrated Image Guide Low Sidelobe Level Leaky-Wave Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A Ku-band low sidelobe level (SLL) leaky-wave antenna fed by the substrate integrated image guide (SIIG) is proposed in this paper. By utilizing the single-layer PCB technology, the fabrication complexity for an SIIG is reduced. The element spacing of the antenna based on the SIIG can be reduced because the SIIG owns a small waveguide wavelength. Rectangular strips are etched on the top of the SIIG as radiation elements, which exhibit strong radiation ability. Thus, the antenna based on the structure can be realized in a short length with high gain and shaped beam. The gain is 14.4dBi at 13.6 GHz, and the SLL is - 19.2dB. The radiation efficiency is 84.5%.

articleTitle: Time Response Analysis of cable over Anisotropic Half space
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The time response of cable over anisotropic ground is discussed by Time Domain Integral Equation (TDIE) method, and the reflected waveform of anisotropic half-space is obtained by the General Transition Matrix (GTM) method combined with Fourier transform. The variation of induced current of the cable with different incident conditions is summarized.

articleTitle: Graphene-based reconfigurable terahertz Split-Ring Resonator metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a reconfigurable terahertz split-ring resonator metamaterial using graphene is designed for terahertz applications. The shaped single-layer graphene sheet is placed on top of the dielectric layer, which consists of Si and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The simulation results show that the resonant frequency can be dynamically tuned under different chemical potential in a wide range.

articleTitle: A Switched-beam Substrate-Integrated Dielectric Resonator Antenna without Beamforming Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel switched-beam substrate-integrated array antenna without beamforming network is presented in this paper. This antenna consists of three substrate-integrated dielectric resonator antennas (DRAs) which are formed using Air holes and metalized vias. Three microstrip are used to feed these elements through the slots. The air holes and metalized vias are properly arranged so that there exists a path between every two elements. As a result, whatever radiator is excited, the input power can be coupled to all radiators and different field distributions are generated, leading to three different radiation beams. Therefore, a complex beamforming feeding network is eliminated in this design. For demonstration, a switched-beam DRA working at 24 GHz is designed. The simulated main beam directions are found to be 0° and ±20° with the antenna gain varying from 6.43 to 6.72 dBi.

articleTitle: Turbulence induced beam wander effect on laser satellite communication systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the modified spectrum model is used to describe the atmospheric turbulence effects of the laser in the troposphere, and the propagation model of Gaussian beams in the atmosphere is established. The transmission characteristics of Gaussian beams in the atmospheric turbulence is studied and the results are closer to actual situation.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Devices Using Discriminating Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents three kinds of multifunctional devices using discriminating coupling. The designs of filtering power divider (FPD), filtering balun as well as filtering power amplifier (PA) are achieved to avoid cascaded mismatch and reduce the overall circuit sizes. Theory of discriminating coupling is analyzed to control the harmonics of the devices. Thus, the fundamental and harmonic responses can be designed respectively. For demonstrations, a FPD and a filtering balun using low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) technology are fabricated for the wide stopband. Meanwhile, a filtering PA in printed circuit board (PCB) process is realized for the efficiency and bandwidth enhancement.

articleTitle: A Novel Wideband Dual-Pol CPW-fed Patch Antenna for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the design and analysis of a novel wideband dual-polarization coplanar waveguide (CPW)-fed antenna for wireless communication systems is presented. The antenna can realize two orthogonal polarizations with low cross-polarization level by exciting two ports respectively. The proposed antenna has a small size of $60 \times 60 \times 1.6$ mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and the impedance bandwidth of the proposed antenna is as large as 66% relative to the centre frequency of 2.13 GHz. The antenna has many advantages, including low cross-polarization level, wide-bandwidth (1.42-2.83 GHz) and good isolation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Network Location Model of Charging Stations Based on Central Place Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a dynamic network location model (DNLM) to reflect the growth and evolution of charging stations over time. To get DNLM, central place theory, cost and investment is added to the stochastic flow-capturing location model. Furthermore, we discuss the relationship between the number of charging stations and EVs, making up for the spatial and temporal dynamics of DNLM. Finally, a multi-objective programming model is built to solve the growth plan timeline of charging stations in Uruguay.

articleTitle: Review of SIW Power Capacity and Verification on Multi-Physics Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Aiming at investigating the power capacity of Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW), the basic principles of SIW power capacity are reviewed in this work, along with the study of influence factors of power capacity in detail. Furthermore, multiphysics software is used to verify the electric field and temperature field of SIW. Good agreements between the theoretical and simulated result are achieved indicating the simulations are valuable for the analysis of power capacity.

articleTitle: Coupling Scattering Mechanism Analysis of Partition Ship Target on The Ocean-like Rough Surface
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a solution to accurately calculate amplitude and position of the equivalent parametric scattering center as for the effect of maritime partition ship target with ocean-like rough surface. In this approach, the effects of the ocean-like rough surface to each component of the ship can be calculated quantitatively based on forward establishing scattering center parameterized model method The coupling scattering mechanism of the surface sea and ship components is analyzed quantitatively by weighted ray theory, which may verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the simulation results in examples.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Finite Frequency Selective Surface Fringe Effect to Wave-transparent Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the fringe effect for wave transmission of the finite FSS is explored. Different parameters that account for the fringe effect are investigated. Both qualitative and quantitative analysis are given to reveal the mechanism of fringe effect for FSS.

articleTitle: A Novel Transient Electric Field Sensor Based on Microstrip structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A kind of novel transient electric field sensor is presented in this paper. The sensor is based on the microstrip structure set on a shielding box. The excitation signal can be recovered by numerical processing of the output signal. The simulated result shows the bandwidth of the sensor covers from DC to 2.1 GHz. Moreover, both the simulated results and the measured results show that the recovered waveform is in good agreement with the excitation waveform. This kind of sensor can be used to capture the transient electric field with the rise time of several nanoseconds.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Endfire Antenna With H-shaped Resonator Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A wideband endfire antenna is presented in this paper. The gain enhancement is achieved by loading with an H-shaped resonator (HSR)structure in the endfire direction. Broad bandwidth is realized by using a microstrip-to-coplanar balun and bowtie dipole elements while gain enhancement is achieved by loading H-shaped resonator (HSR) structure in the endfire direction. The measurements show the HSRs-loaded antenna presents gain of about 4dB-8dB in the whole working band (4.5GHz-9.5 GHz), which is about 2 dB more than the unloaded one. The advantages of broad bandwidth and high gain make this antenna valuable in wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Dealing with Optimality in New Generation Arrays for Telecom and Radars
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new generation of design methodologies, is necessary to allow the use of phased array technology in the near future radar and telecommunication systems. This work presents a review of the state of art approaches, including the recent advancement in the design of unconventional architectures and simplified antenna array solutions. An illustrative numerical result is reported as an example of the reviewed approaches.

articleTitle: Modeling of Cylindrical Cables Based on PEEC Method and a Surface Admittance Operator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a fast and efficient modeling method for cylindrical cables based on PEEC method and a surface admittance operator. The proposed method uses an admittance operator to build new basis functions, which can make the calculation of partial impedance and partial inductance faster and capture the current distribution caused by skin effect (SE) and proximity effect (PE). Simulation examples confirm the accuracy and efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Composite Material Dielectric Constant Measuring Device and Method under Stress
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a device and method for measuring the dielectric constant of composites under stress. Based on the traditional free space measurement system, a stress loading mechanism is added to change the stress of the material. In addition, due to slight displacement of the material during stress, we also proposes a measurement method that is different from the traditional free space method. The measurement method proposed in this paper removes the impact of displacement and thickness changes on the S-parameter, and can accurately invert the relative change of the dielectric constant when the material is stressed.

articleTitle: Higher Order Modes Analysis of a HEMP Simulator Using Time-Domain Simulation and Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Higher order modes is crucial to analysis field uniformity, radiation leakage and destructive of the fundamental mode. The electric field generated inside the working area of the guided-wave EMP simulator can be represented as the combination of the dominant transverse electromagnetic (TEM) and higher order modes of transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM). In this paper time domain finite integral method (FITD) has been used to computed field data and singular value decomposition (SVD) technique has been used to extract the higher order modes of the existing guided-wave EMP simulator.

articleTitle: The Wave Propagation Characteristics of the Plasma Sheath Were Analyzed by COMSOL
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, the propagation characteristics of electromagnetic wave in non-uniform plasma sheath are studied by using COMSOL, a commercial software based on finite element method. The transmission coefficient of inhomogeneous plasma sheath is calculated by using plane electromagnetic wave as excitation source. This paper discusses the influence of plasma electron density on the electromagnetic wave propagation when the spacecraft re-enters the atmosphere. The calculation results provide theoretical basis for solving the problem of “black barrier”.

articleTitle: Element-Theory Based Grading of Electromagnetic Environment Complexity
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To solve the precise quantification of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) performance of complex systems and the priority of system-level EMC design, an EMC classification method for complex systems based on unascertained measure theory is presented. Those five indexes, including interference threshold, sensitive threshold, spectrum occupancy rate, coupling influence degree and influenced degree which are easy to be obtained in practical engineering design, are selected as evaluation indices. Finally, credible degree recognition criterion is adapted to define EMC level, which provide certain method guidance for equipment priority in system-level EMC design.

articleTitle: A Q-Band Substrate Integrated Dual-Slot Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A planar Q-band substrate integrated dual-slot antenna is proposed in this paper, aiming at the upcoming 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> generation wireless communications. The proposed antenna has two parallel 45°-inclined slots on the broad wall of the SIW with a modified shorted termination to achieve wideband and an improved gain performance. The operating principle has been discussed, and a circularly polarized antenna is designed based on the proposed dual-slot antenna.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile, Dual-Polarized Base-Station Antenna with FSS Loading
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a low profile dual-polarized base station antenna element loaded with frequency selective surface (FSS) is presented. Owning to the FSS loading over radiating aperture, it achieves a profile height reduction from quarter wavelength to 0.12λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> (λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is the free-space wavelength referring to the antenna center frequency), while maintains the operating bandwidth from 0.69 GHz to 0.96 GHz for VSWR<;1.8 and 9.6±0.8 dBi gain over the entire frequency band. The size of the antenna is 300×300×45 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Full-wave simulations verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A quantitative analysis of the lock-in phase difference in terahertz time-domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS), the THz electric field strength is generally characterized by the photocurrent of the THz receiver, which is extracted from the in-phase component output of lock-in amplifier (LIA) in the system. As to LIA, the in-phase output is directly influenced by the phase difference between the voltage/current input (the signal of THz receiver) and the reference signal. Since the changing of phase difference during testing the sample is often ignored in the experiments, a quantitative and rounded analysis of the effect on the result is presented in this paper to provide a go-to source for the researchers who are interested in this issue.

articleTitle: Numerical De-embedding of Periodic Guided-wave Structures via SOC/SOL in FEM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a 3D full-wave finite element method (FEM) combined with short-open calibration (SOC) and short-open-load (SOL) technique. In order to accurately acquire the intrinsic propagation characteristics of various guided-wave structures, our proposed SOC/SOL technique is successfully incorporated into 3D full-wave FEM algorithm/solver. Hence, the port discontinuities between the core guided-wave structure and the feeding network can be effectively removed out. Thus, the intrinsic unite-length parameters including their propagation constants and characteristic/wave impedances can be finally achieved. A few numerical examples are given out to demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of our proposed full-wave approach.

articleTitle: Emission Measurement of Phased Arrays Using A Ultra-Wideband Dual Polarized Vivaldi Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new method of measuring the emission characteristics of phased array transmitter by receiving array antenna is proposed. Compared to traditional method that only gets the suppression of harmonic and spurious emission, the proposed method that based on direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation and broadband sweep measurement also measures the effect of spatial power-combining which is significant for beamforming. The influence of mutual coupling on array response is described in detail. The validity of the method of measurement and the design of the receiving array antenna are verified by numerical calculations and measured data.

articleTitle: Ka-band Planar H-plane Horn Array with Reduced Sidelobe Level
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A 1 × 4 dipole array loaded substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) H-plane horn array with an element spacing of 2.3λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is proposed. Phase corrected structure is adopted to reduce the sidelobe level of the array caused by the large element spacing. The 1 × 4 horn array has a wide bandwidth of 31% (from 28.0 to 38.5 GHz) and a stable gain up to 15.6 dBi.

articleTitle: Design of A Novel Compact Structure of A Wide-Slot Circularly Polarized Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel structure of a compact circularly polarized antenna is proposed. All antenna dimensions are subject to EM-driven design closure to ensure the best possible performance in terms of the impedance and axial ratio bandwidth. The antenna features a wide impedance bandwidth of 42.6% (3.93-6.06 GHz) and axial ratio bandwidth of 42% (3.96-6.03) while retaining the small size of only $24.7\times 25$ mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The average realized gain of the antenna throughout the operating band is 3.4 dB.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Resolution of Impulse Signal Circular Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The characteristics of impulse signal circular synthetic aperture radar imaging is analyzed in this paper. The point spread functions of point target back projection algorithm imaging are derived in azimuth and range, and then the azimuth and range resolution is calculated. The azimuth resolution improves as the observation angle increases and the range resolution deteriorates as the observation angle increases. The correctness of derived results is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: 3-D Linear Reconstruction of the Experimental Fresnel Data by the GMMV Inversion Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the generalized multiple measurement vectors (GMMV) linear inversion method is applied to the reconstruction of the 3-D Fresnel data, provided by the Institue Fresnel (Marseille, France). The results show that the GMMV-based method can obtain good resolution along the xand yaxes, while poor resolution along the z-axis, because there were only receiving antennas distributed on the x-o-y plane, indicating that the diversity of the measurement angle is critical for the GMMV method.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Wideband Filtering Hybrid Ring Coupler with Super Wide Upper Stopband
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a filtering hybrid ring coupler is proposed with an ultra-wideband passband and a super wide upper stopband. Both double-sided parallel-strip line swap phase inverter and electromagnetic bandgap structures are used. It takes the area of 0.92 × 0.7 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to provide a 110% wide passband centered at 1.55 GHz. Good in-band reflection, port isolation, magnitude and phase balances are achieved for both the in- and out-of-phase excitations. The rejection from the upper cutoff frequency to 20 GHz is over 20 dB.

articleTitle: Efficient Leapfrog LOD-FDTD Method for Periodic Structures at Oblique Incidence
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To solve the issues of obliquely incident plane wave on periodic structures, an efficient Leapfrog locally one-dimensional (LOD) FDTD method was proposed in this paper. Firstly, by applying the LOD scheme into the improved split-field algorithm, unconditional stability can be achieved. And then, by introducing three auxiliary variables, the one-step Leapfrog implementation for the LOD scheme was derived. Compared with the traditional periodic LOD-FDTD algorithm [5], the proposed method is more efficient and needs the less stored memory. At last, numerical results were given to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultra-wideband Dual-polarized Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel ultra-wideband dual-polarized antenna with feed network is proposed. The antenna is made up of two logarithmic period folded dipole antennas (LPFDAs) that are orthogonal to each other. The reflection coefficient is lower than - 10 dB from 0.5 GHz to 6 GHz, the port isolation is below -25dB, and the cross polarization in the end fire direction is lower than - 30 dB. The back and side lobes are low.

articleTitle: A Wide-Beam Planar Antenna Based on High Impedance Surface
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a wide-beam planar antenna based on high impedance surface is proposed. It is demostrated that by using a mushroom-type high impedance surface as the antenna ground, a conventional dipole can realize a broad beamwidth as covering the entire upper hemisphere in the E-plane, which is totally different from the radiation pattern of the conventional dipole. Calculated results shows that the proposed antenna can realize a broad 3dB beam-width of 189 ° in the E-plane at 1.73GHz.

articleTitle: Fast Evaluation of Backscattering by Dynamic Objects Using Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An efficient method for simulation of scattering by a dynamic object is developed in this paper. To deal with the dynamic behavior of a moving object, which amounts to being illuminated from an arbitrary direction, the principal component analysis method is adopted, so that an arbitrary incident wave is expressed as a superposition of principal excitations. Compared with solving the dynamic object at every moment, the proposed approach is much more efficient due to succinct uses of principal component analysis.

articleTitle: Broadband Thin Film Transition From GCPW to Waveguide In D-band
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, an on-chip thin film transition from Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit (MMIC) to waveguide is realized based on a dipole antenna structure. The transition is implemented on a 100-μm-thick InP substrate and placed in the E-plane of an air-filled WR-7 waveguide. The transition shows a maximum insertion loss of 1.5 dB and a minimum of 1.2 dB across the frequency range 110-170 GHz. The minimum return loss of the transition is 29 dB and the maximum is 10 dB.

articleTitle: A Wideband Composite Cavity-Backed Modified Foursquare Antenna With Enhanced Patterns
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An modified Foursquare antenna with wide bandwidth and unidirectional operation is presented that employs a composite backing cavity for stable radiation pattern. The antenna is composed of two radiating square patches and two parasitic tear-shaped patches. The antenna is fed by a SMA connector through a balun from microstrip line to parallel stripline. Simulated results show that the antenna achieves an impedance bandwidth of 116.5% for VSWR ≤ 2 from 2.9 to 11 GHz, a broadside gain of 7.2-12.2 dBi and a stable unidirectional radiation pattern.

articleTitle: Analysis of Conical Antenna with Continuous Resistor Loaded
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new two-dimensional FDTD method for computing the radiation near fields of conical antenna with continuous resistor at each layer along z-axis, is given in this paper. And the resistors' value at the layer is varied as an exponential function and a linear function respectively. The EMP's effect of that different type of resistor load is numerical studied and analyzed. The results show that both of the two resistor load manner can reduce the reflection from the antenna's end, and we can choose appropriate load type according to the reality.

articleTitle: Electro-thermal coupled analysis of MOSFET under IEMI
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Analysis of MOSFET under intentionally electromagnetic interferences (IEMIs) has been taken by using the self-developed electro-thermal software since this external interferences have been blamed for unexplained breakdowns and burnouts of many vulnerable electronic circuits and systems. This paper focused on the thermal effects of MOSFET affected by IEMIs. The physical mechanism of the heat source in MOSFET are numerical studied by the simulation based on drift-diffusion model (DDM) which coupled with thermal response of carriers. The generation and diffusion of heat inside the device are discussed. The simulation results can be applied in damage mechanism analysis and harden designs of circuits against the IEMI and other external electromagnetic interferences.

articleTitle: A Scattering Center Model for Travelling Waves on Planar Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A mathematical model for the scattering centers induced by traveling waves on planar surfaces is proposed in this work. This model presents the concise, analytical descriptions of the location and the dependencies on the aspect angle and frequency for the scattering center. Numerical results of the radar cross-sections (RCS) and the time-frequency representations (TFR) show that the contribution of the surface waves to total fields is too strong to be ignored at some observing angles. To validate this model, the scattered waves from a rectangular plate and a trapezoidal plate are simulated, and are compared with the results computed by a full-wave method. The results show that good agreements are achieved by this model.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency Domain Decomposition Method of Hybrid Finite Element-Boundary Integral for Composite Electromagnetic Problems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To accurately and efficiently analyse large-scale and composite electromagnetic problems, an improved complete domain decomposition method (CDDM) of the hybrid finite element-boundary integral (FE-BI) is proposed in this paper. The recently proposed CDDM of FE-UI effectively integrates volume-based nonconformal Schwarz FE-DDM and surface-based nonconformal interior penalty UI-DDM, which has been proved to be flexible and powerful for time-harmonic scattering and radiation problems. To further improve its capability, a new cost-effective additive Schwarz preconditioner is introduced. The new preconditioner is constructed from sparse submatrices which is obtained by rarefying the FE-BI submatrix based on the characteristics of boundary integral equation. Comparing with the previous matrix system, the new preconditioned matrix system consumes less memory and time under the premise of fast convergence. The capability of the improved CDDM of FE-BI is demonstrated by numerical experiments closing to realistic application.

articleTitle: Design of Reconfigurable Metal Photonic Crystal Array for Directional EM Wave Propagation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A kind of reconfigurable metal photonic crystal arraynis designed for directional electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation at microwave frequency. Dispersion curves of Energy band theory of photonic crystals are computed and combined with the theory of finite thickness periodic arrays for designing the directional EM wave propagation arrays. The designed array can be transformed between a finite thickness hexagonal lattice array and two finite thickness rectangular lattice arrays by raising or lowering a part of metal rods. A radiation source located in the center of the hexagonal lattice array can get good directionality at 3.1GHz. When the array is transformed into the rectangular lattice array by raising or lowering a part of metal rods, the directional radiation direction can be changed ±30 degrees at the same frequency of 3.1GHz.

articleTitle: A Software Automation Implementation Method for Generating Parametric Scattering Center Models of Complex Targets
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a software automation implementation method for generating parametric scattering center models of complex targets, the only required input to the software named RTPA is a computer-aided design (CAD) model of the target, which has been multilevel disassembled, finally, the scattering center model can be automatically outputted by the software. Following this, we establish parametric models of BTR70 target, reconstruct the radar characteristics and compare with the measured data, the parametric model is evaluated by quantitative evaluation index. The validities of the method are verified through the results.

articleTitle: A Method for Optimizing Far Field Quiet zone Taper of Antenna Measurement
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In the design and construction of far-field of antenna measurement, big quiet area and small chamber size is with contradiction, this paper attempts to explore how to ease this contradiction. In this paper, the quiet zone taper model is deduced, and the expression of the “ideal” antenna radiation amplitude and phase function can be obtained, which indicates that the radiation phase characteristic is critical. Then a FDTD simulation model of 0.8 GHz ~ 23 GHz broadband horn antenna is established. The simulation results show that the antenna phase characteristic presents as an “ideal” curve. If the theory can be realized in engineering, chamber length can be compressed and significant investment in construction can be saved.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of 3D Anisotropic Permittivities and Sensitivity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Inverse scattering methods have been used in the reconstruction of objects in a variety of areas such as radar scattering, subsurface sensing, biomedical imaging and nondestructive evaluation for decades. The scatter properties such as conductivity, permittivity and permeability as well as location and shape are reconstructed from the scattered electromagnetic fields. There are mainly two categories of inversion methods. One is the pixel-based method. In this method, the inverted parameters are the material properties, such as the permittivity and conductivity in each pixel. It is very suitable for objects with highly inhomogeneous media. Another category of method is model-based method. In this method, the inversion domain is divided into regions. The shapes of different regions are described using geometrical parameters. The inverted parameters are the shapes of regions and the material properties for each region. Compared to the pixel-based method, model-based method is often more efficient since the number of inverted parameters are highly reduced and the a priori information are used.

articleTitle: Design of a Frequency Selective Surface with a Transmissive Window and two Bidirectional Absorptive Bands
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a frequency selective surface (FSS) with a transmissive window and two bidirectional absorptive bands is investigated. A triple-layer structure consisting of two lossy and a lossless FSS was employed. A four-legged loaded elements and square slots were used in the design of the lossy and lossless FSS. Simulation results indicated that a passband covered from 4.2 to 5.8 GHz with a center frequency of 5 GHz were obtained. Two absorptive bands that bidirectionally absorb the incident power were achieved on both side of the passband.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Electromagnetic Modeling for Underwater Targets and Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The three-dimensional electromagnetic modeling of underwater targets is faced with complex environmental, low-frequency breakdown and large/multi-scale problems, which proposed high demands on the calculation method and speed. In this paper, the three-dimensional vector finite element method was combined with Neumann boundary conditions to achieve fast and accurate solution to the low-frequency and large-scale problem. The numerical examples showed the efficiency of the method to the three-dimensional underwater targets and environment.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Broadband and Highpower Shipboard Whip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A broadband whip antenna with 10 meters length is designed to optimize its impedance to 3:1 VSWR over 3-30 MHz frequency range. This antenna which has two loading sections incorporating RLC lumped circuit elements and an LC matching network containing transformer, is capable of accepting 1 kilowatts of RF input power. A prototype of the HF broadband whip antenna is built and test to verify the design. The experimental results agree well with those from theoretical calculations.

articleTitle: The design and experimental verification of broadband absorbing structure combined by resin and lossy periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: With the aim to design a particular broadband absorbing structure, a multi-layer structure was proposed by combining resin and square patch periodic structures. The absorbing structure was fabricated by resin curing process and screen printing process. The computational and experimental results showed that the reflectivity could be lower than -10dB at5.4-18GHz with a total thickness of 5.7mm. This effective enhancement on EM wave absorption performance was believed to be a consequence of resonance effect and destructive interference induced by lossy periodic structures.

articleTitle: A Fast Solver to Calculate the Creeping Wave Fields From the NURBS Scatterers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new method to calculate geodesic on the Non-Uniform Rational B-spline (NURBS) surfaces is proposed. With Heuns method, the accuracy of geodesic can be improved, which is important in the future researches of scattered fields. The bridge between NURBS surfaces and the variables needed in the calculation of geodesic is also built in the paper. The validity and efficiency of the method is verified by numerical results.

articleTitle: In Celebration of 70th Birthday of Prof. Jia-dong Xu
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Prof. Jia-dong Xu has been regarded as one of the most distinguished scholars in electromagnetics. This session is in the honor of him on his 70th birthday. A brief biography of Prof. Jia-dong Xu is given highlighting his professional achievements.

articleTitle: A wideband filter-integrated coupler using substrate integrated suspended line (SISL) technology with patterned substrate
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A wideband coupled-line coupler based on substrate integrated suspended line (SISL) technology was proposed. The coupler has a conventional coupled line, two variant two-line coupled lines, and four three-line coupled lines, with filtering-integrated function and inherent DC block. By introducing two air cavities and removing certain parts of the substrate, a patterned SISL structure was utilized, with the advantages of self-packaged, low loss, and simple production and processing. The designed coupler has a power-division ratio of 7 dB, and a wide frequency band from 1.21 GHz to 2.11 GHz (54.21%) with S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> <; -15 dB, centered at 1.66 GHz.

articleTitle: A Self-Activated Band-pass FSS with Field Intensity Dependent Electromagnetic Scattering Ability
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel design of a band-pass frequency selective surface (FSS) with adjustable electromagnetic (EM) scattering characteristics is presented. The unit cell of the FSS consists of both linear and nonlinear lumped elements. The embedded nonlinear elements can be excited by a strong incident wave and hence the FSS can be self-activated. According to different field intensity of an incident wave, the scattering field of the FSS can be coded. For demonstration, a band-pass FSS with both PIN diodes and capacitors is simulated and analyzed by using a commercial full-wave solver in time domain.
