The results show the field intensity dependent EM scattering characteristic of the FSS with flexible beam control.

articleTitle: A Compact Reconfigurable coaxial slot antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this letter, a compact reconfigurable coaxial antenna with orthogonal slots containing switches is presented. Switch structure consists of PIN diode which is lapped at the midpoint of coaxial slot. Slots are structured as slot array to ensure high gain performance. The slot works well when the diode is open, but doesn’t work when the diode is short. The front slots with PIN-diode switches being open and the backwards slots with PIN-diode switches being short, so the directive beam is achieved in the front, and it scans in the azimuth plane with the PIN-diodes switching.

articleTitle: A Retro-Reflective Beamforming Scheme based on Heterodyne Technique for Wireless Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A retro-reflective beamforming scheme based on the heterodyne technique is experimentally demonstrated for wireless power transmission applications. Compared with the conventional heterodyne scheme, the wireless power transmitter does not include any local oscillators. It receives 2.9-GHz pilot signal broadcasted by a wireless power receiver, employs a frequency doubler to obtain the second harmonic signal at 5.8 GHz, and subsequently uses the 5.8-GHz signal to achieve phase conjugation. Experimental results clearly indicate that the proposed scheme is able to deliver directive wireless power beam to the wireless power receiver in reaction to the pilot signal.

articleTitle: A Study on the Propagation Characteristics of AIS Signals in the Evaporation Duct Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The propagation characteristics of the Automatic Identification System (AIS) in the evaporation duct environment over the sea surface are investigated by using the parabolic equation method. The parabolic equation method has excellent stability and accuracy in solving the computational problem of electromagnetic wave propagation under different atmospheric conditions and it is probably the most suitable for the purpose of analyzing AIS signals. The propagation of AIS signals in air is determined by the variation of the refractivity with height. For AIS transmission, ducting propagation may be the most important propagation mechanism. The propagation loss of AIS signals in the evaporation duct is simulated and compared with that for the case of the standard atmosphere. The simulation results show that evaporation duct has little influence on the AIS signals.

articleTitle: Reconstruction the Orbital Velocity Field of Ship Wake by the Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a least square (LSQ) based method for reconstructing the orbital velocity field (OVF) of ship wake from available wake elevation. The method first reconstructs the surface geometry of the wake by monochromatic waves over some specified range of wavelengths and propagating angles. Then, using the same expansion coefficients, the OVF of the wake can be reconstructed via a linear superposition of the OVFs of monochromatic waves. The new algorithm is easy to implement in SAR imagery and is particularly suitable for numerical wake where the OVF is usually not available.

articleTitle: A D-Band Down-Conversion Mixer Based on 65 nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a low-power broadband Gilbert down-conversion mixer is presented. Using the weak inversion biasing technique and a broadband Marchand balun design, the mixer achieves a flat gain of 3~4 dB at LO power of 0 dBm from 110GHz to 170GHz, and the input referred 1dB compression point is -7dBm. The ring mixer shows excellent port isolation, LO-RF, LO-IF, RF-IF isolation is greater than 30dB, 40dB and 43.4dB, respectively. The chip is designed in 65nm CMOS technology and the core size is 0.28mm × 0.28mm, the chip size including all pads is 0.26 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The total power consumption is 4mW from a 1.2V supply voltage.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Shared-Aperture Circular Phased Array for Generating OAM Beams
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a novel dual-band shared-aperture circular phased array for producing orbital angular momentum (OAM)beams at both C- and X-bands with the center frequency of 5.8 and 10 GHz, respectively. Two circular phased arrays are combined in the common aperture, where the X-band array is mounted in the centre of the antenna substrate and the C-band array is mounted around X-band elements. To verify the design concept, one prototype is fabricated and measured. The measured results agree well with the simulated results, showing that +1 mode OAM beams are obtained with the gain around 12 dBi at C- and X- bands. The divergence angle of the radiation patterns at 5.8 GHz and 10 GHz is 15° and 16°, respectively.

articleTitle: A CP Antipodal Tapered Slot Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper present a substrate-integrated waveguide based CP antipodal tapered slot antenna (ATSA) for fifth-generation (5G) mobile communication. The proposed antenna comprises a dielectric substrate, a pair of grooves which is arranged in the substrate symmetrically and linearly, and two metal patch on top and bottom of the structure in order to improve the radiation performance. The simulation results show that the antenna axis ratio is below 3dB and the peak realized gain is more than 11dB over the two wideband range from 24.3GHz to 36GHz and 36.7GHz to 42.7GHz. The relative bandwidth is about 52.8%.

articleTitle: A Novel Planar Mode-Transducing Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel planar mode-transducing antenna is proposed. The proposed antenna could accept directly microwave energy in an azimuthally symmetric mode and radiate a high-gain linear polarized mode, which is a good potential candidate for the high-power microwave system.

articleTitle: Terahertz Scattering of Electrically Large and Complex Target
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: For terahertz wave, we only need to know rough surface profiles to calculate RCS of simple target. But for the complex and electrically large target, this paper uses a semi deterministic and semi statistical idea, which divides the scattering of targets into coherent and incoherent scattering. Coherent scattering is based on high frequency approximation, and incoherent scattering is calculated by rough surface scattering theory. Thus, the terahertz scattering characteristics of complex targets can be analyzed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Absorbers based on Random Metasurface combined with Graphene
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new kind of absorber with ultra-wideband microwave absorption is designed, which is combined with graphene and random metasurface. As a result, when the sheet resistance of graphene varies from 350 Ω/square to 700 Ω/square, the absorption above 80% ranging from 5 to 31GHz (144% relative bandwidth) is obtained.

articleTitle: Second-Order Tri-Band Frequency Selective Surface with High Selectivity
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a tri-band frequency selective surface (FSS) with second-order response is presented by cascading a two-layer periodic array. The proposed FSS provides three pass-bands that are separated from one another by two transmission zeros, leading to a highly selective response. Each pass-band contains two transmission poles, which results in a broad and flat band performance. The central frequencies of three pass-bands are 5.5GHz, 8.7GHz, 11.7GHz and the corresponding bandwidths are 1.0GHz, 1.3GHz, 0.7GHz, respectively. The simulation is implemented using full wave electromagnetic wave simulator CST Microwave Studio, and the operating principle is also described. Furthermore, the FSS has the merits of polarization insensitivity and incident angle stability.

articleTitle: A Characteristic Mode View of Electrically Small Unidirectional Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Maximum available directivity (D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>) for any arbitrary structure can be found using characteristic modes. It is theoretically achievable by placing multiple ports properly. This paper proposes the procedure of determining the voltage of each port by deriving the numerical expression of modal weighting coefficients. Numerical experiments for achieving D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> of electrically small structures could provide guidelines for practical unidirectional small antenna design.

articleTitle: Multiple Beamforming with TMAs controlled by Periodic Nyquist Pulsed Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: TMAs are able to provide beamforming of multiple power data stream patterns by applying periodic pulses to the antenna elements. The effectiveness of the technique depends on the ability of such pulses to accurately window the working harmonics. In this regard, rectangular pulses show serious windowing limitations when more than a single harmonic pattern is to be synthesized. With the purpose of efficiently selecting and handling multiple harmonic patterns, we propose the control of TMAs with periodic Nyquist pulsed signals due to their particularly suitable spectral features.

articleTitle: Design of A Dual-polarization Full-Corporate-Fed Waveguide Slot 4x4 Subarray for Ka-band
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A 4x4-element waveguide slot antenna sub-array for Ka-band is proposed in this paper to achieve high-efficiency and high-gain, wideband characteristics of antenna in the millimeter-wave band. This full-corporate-fed slot antenna can avoid long-line effect-which is a limit to the bandwidth of the antenna. It is also an effective way to improve the uniformity of two kinds of polarizations. The simulated bandwidth for VSWR lower than 1.5 is 9% (horizontal port) and 5.7% (vertical port) respectively. The isolation is more than 50dB over the bandwidth, and 19.2dBi is obtained at the design frequency. The array has an 18.8dBi gain and 6.6%, 5.1% bandwidth in measurement. The 4x4-element can b e used as an important unit to compose the whole array to realize high gain.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis on Crosstalk of the Parallel Meander Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this communication, the parallel meander transmission lines (PMTLs) are studied and analyzed in frequency-domain to understand the crosstalk. The performance of the transmission characteristic, reflection characteristic and crosstalk of the parallel transmission lines with different bending angles are investigated and compared in details. Additionally, equivalent circuit model is also discussed to provide an effective analysis method for understanding the crosstalk of the PMTLs. The co-simulation of the HFSS and ADS are used to analyze the crosstalk, and the simulation results show that the crosstalk is minimal at the bend angles of 105 degree and 135 degree. Moreover, the equivalent circuit model agrees well with the HFSS simulation.

articleTitle: A Study on Adaptive Nulling Using Evolutionary Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Most adaptive antennas require digital beamforming to create the covariance matrix necessary to form nulls in the directions of interference. We present a study on power minimization adaptive nulling using evolutionary search algorithms. The numerical results show that these techniques can achieve desirable signal to interference ratios with the added advantage of low cost implementation.

articleTitle: On the spectrum detector based on the Fourier transform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The conventional spectrum analyzer (or receiver) detect the spectrums of time signal not accurately and approximately. In this paper an accurate spectrum detection method of spectrum analyzer based on the Fourier transform is presented. The results are accurate and unique. New detector is superior to convention spectrum detector of spectrum analyzer.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection Using Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging and Distorted Born Iterative Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Breast cancer is a major threatening disease to women's life nowadays. To ensure a surviving chance for the patients, it is quite crucial to detect and treat the breast cancer in the early stage. This article deals with the detection of breast cancer using two different microwave imaging methods. The first method is based on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) qualitative imaging method, and the second is based on inverse scattering quantitative imaging method, which can also reconstruct the relative permittivity for the breast. A two-dimensional simplified breast phantom is used to test both algorithms and the imaging results show that both methods are able to detect the cancer cell with good resolution.

articleTitle: Squint SAR imaging of complex targets on the sea
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper use ANSYS software to establish a high-precision 3D model of a naval vessel and to divide the target surface into triangle mesh. The frequency signal stepped radar wave is adopted for detection, using a high-frequency method based on physical optics (PO) double bounce combines with the theory of Incremental Length Diffraction Coefficient (ILDC) to estimate the broadband backscattering field of marine vessels. Performing discrete Fourier transform (IDFT) on the echo signals in the frequency domain to obtain two-dimensional beamed SAR images. The ray theory was used to analyze the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of sea targets and the coupling imaging mechanism, verifying the accuracy and effectiveness of the simulation results.

articleTitle: Retrospect of Space Solar Power Stations History
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Development of space solar power stations is reviewed around the world and in China, respectively. A few typical systems are investigated, including SSPS-ALPHA, Tethered-SPS and MR-SPS. The key technologies are noted of space solar power stations.

articleTitle: Sparse Wideband Linear Arrays Synthesis via Compressive Processing Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work the synthesis of sparse wideband linear arrays is addressed. An innovative Compressive Processing (CP)-based methodology is proposed for the minimization of the number of elements, still guaranteeing good pattern performances within a wide bandwidth of frequencies. Finally, a simple numerical example validates the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Dualband Filter using Stub-Loaded Resonators
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this letter, we propose a dual-band filter using stub-loaded resonators. The dual-band filter is analysed by odd and even mode analysis. For the open loaded stub condition, the main line controls both the lower and upper frequencies and the stub only controls the upper band frequency. By contrast the main line effect both the lower and upper frequencies and the short stub only controls the lower band frequency for short loaded stub condition. So the each band can be tuned independently through changing the length of each stub. Then given work frequency bands, physical dimensions of the structure can be easily deduced. Thus, based on full-wave simulation, the proposed design is verified.

articleTitle: Localized Plasmonic Enhanced Waveguide Modulator with High Speed Tunability Using Graphene
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A nanoantenna based waveguide modulator with high speed tunability using graphene has been achieved. The localized plasmon resonance of the nanoantennas caused by the effective coupling of the waveguide mode greatly enhance the light-graphene interaction, as demonstrated here, a 500 GHz modulation rate with an active device area of just 0.16 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is presented.

articleTitle: Fast Scattering Center Extraction with DDM based on Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In our work, compressive sensing (CS) is employed in domain decomposition method (DDM) to construct a new incident source with much fewer excitation waves to obtain the compressed induced currents, and then they are reconstructed by recovery algorithm. The proposed CS-based DDM algorithm requires much fewer sampling data to extract Radar-Cross Section (RCS) from strong scattering centers of the target validly. Meanwhile, the complexity of computational electromagnetic (CEM) model for solving the multiscale scattering problems is reduced significantly.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on the Fractal Channel of Intracloud Lightning Discharge
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A numerical simulation method for the fractal channel of intracloud lightning discharge is presented, and the influence of the horizontal scale of the thundercloud on the fractal dimension of the discharge channel is also analyzed. The results show that the simulated intracloud lightning discharge channel has obvious fractal structure. The larger the horizontal scale of the thundercloud, the more obvious the branch of the channel and the greater the fractal dimension of the channel.

articleTitle: Adjustable Printed Circuit for Wireless Energy Transmission Based on Magnetic Resonant Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The magnetic resonance coupling wireless energy transfer technology from two aspects of theory and experiment is studied in this work. By using the control variable method, we study the relationship between system transmission and transmission distance.

articleTitle: Novel Methodology for Designing Antenna Arrays with Reduced Number of Elements Based on Differential Evolution with Ranking-Based Mutation Operators
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of designing linear arrays with reduced number of elements and design constraints including the minimum and maximum distance between two adjacent elements. The proposed design method is based on Differential Evolution (DE) with ranking-based mutation operators. In this case, some of the vectors in the mutation operator are probabilistically selected according to their ranking in the current population instead of recurring to a random selection as in the original DE. A comparative study among different DE algorithms is carried out to define the optimum element geometry and set of excitations that produce the desired pattern with a reduced number of elements. The results show that DE enhanced with ranking-based mutation operator is highly efficient and outperforms the common DE variants.

articleTitle: Intelligent EMC Management Fabric Based on Knowledge Base and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new knowledge fabric for electromagnetic compatibility management of mobile phone. It combines the knowledge graph and machine learning to achieve intelligent management. The fabric leverages knowledge base to store entities and relational triples of entities. Moreover, we firstly propose the conception of ”function triple”. By using recurrent neural network methods, the model recognizes entities and their corresponding attributes to reflect the real query intention. When evaluated on a mobile phone task, the accuracy of the fabric is 68.3%. It is practical useful to help engineers to carry out circuit design.

articleTitle: Extraction of Periodicity for Quasi-Periodic Electromagnetic Surfaces Using Equivalence Principle Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Quasi-periodic electromagnetic surfaces have similar planar elements located on periodic lattices. Because the elements are different, the periodic boundary condition is not accurate for full wave modeling of quasi-periodic electromagnetic surfaces. In order to utilize the periodicity of elements to accelerate the full wave simulation, this work applies the idea of equivalence principle algorithm and projects the current of different elements onto periodic equivalence surfaces. The projection process can be written in matrix operators. For unknowns on the equivalence surfaces, the reduced basis method can be applied to reduced the number of unknowns. After extracting the periodicity or the translational invariance of the element alignment, the fast Fourier transform can be used to accelerate matrix vector production in iterative solvers for method of moments. It can reduce the computational complexity of matrix vector production from $O(N^{2})$ to $O(N\log\, N)$, where $N$ is the number of elements. Numerical examples show the algorithm can accelerate iterative solvers and has potential to solve large quasi-periodic electromagnetic surfaces.

articleTitle: Prediction of Residual Fatigue Life of Bolts Based on Metal Magnetic Memory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to predict the residual fatigue life of the bolt by the metal magnetic memory signal, the fatigue tests of the bolt were carried out and the signals of the bolt at different loading cycles were measured. By extracting 48 characteristic parameters as input, a support vector machine (SVM) model is established to predict the residual fatigue life of bolts. The parameters of the model are optimized by using three approaches including grid search, particle swarm and genetic algorithm. The results show that the model has a satisfied accuracy when using genetic algorithm as parameter optimization approach. The model provides a promising way to predict the residual fatigue life of bolts, which is significant for structural integrity management of engineering structures.

articleTitle: A Design of Broadband Feeding Network for Circularly Polarized Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a design of microstrip broadband feeding network for circularly polarized antenna working within X and Ku band. It consists of a broadband Wilkinson power divider and a broadband 90° phase shifter using double T-shaped open stubs loaded transmission line. The phase difference of the two output ports is 90°±5°, and their mutual isolation better than 15dB. This feeding network is fabricated and measured for verification.

articleTitle: Circular-Shaped Uniaxial Perfectly Matched Layer for the FDTD Method in Cartesian System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To reduce unnecessary lattices work of the FDTD method in the traditional Cartesian coordinate system, circular-shaped uniaxial perfectly matched layer strategy is introduced, which can omit four corner regions calculations in the two-dimensional situation, so that the calculation efficiency can be improved and the simulation time can be saved to some extent, compared to the conventional method. Two numerical experiments are simulated to verify the stability and efficiency of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: A Discontinuous Galerkin Method for Scattering From IBC Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A discontinuous Galerkin method (DG) is presented to accurately calculate electromagnetic scattering from objects with impedance boundary condition (IBC) surfaces by using well-conditioned self-dual integral equations (SDIE). More importantly, a better understanding of DG methods is obtained. The superfluous items are omitted from traditional DG methods and an efficient and refined formulation called R-DG-SDIE is proposed. Numerical results demonstrate this proposed R-DG-SDIE formulation has faster convergence and less computation than those directly extended from previous interior penalty (IP) DG formulations.

articleTitle: Analysis on Local Deformation of Microwave Power Transmitting Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To understand the influence of the local deformation on the performance of a microwave power transmission system, the analysis model for the local deformation of the transmitting antenna array is proposed. Based on the analysis model, the local deformation of the transmitting antenna array is investigated for the MW-level SSPS with the construction requirement consequently being specified.

articleTitle: Design of Load Combiner in Three-Stage Doherty Power Amplifier for Bandwidth Extension
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a design of modified load combiner for wideband three-stage Doherty power amplifier (DPA). The proposed design can employ the output impedance of the peaking amplifiers to compensate the effective load impedance of the carrier amplifier in the low-power region for extending the bandwidth. To verify the design method, a 1.7-2.6 GHz three-stage DPA was designed using three 10-W GaN HEMTs. Simulated results show about 50% drain efficiency at 9.5 dB output power back-off over the entire frequency range of operation (42% fractional bandwidth).

articleTitle: A Wideband CP Dielectric Resonator Antenna Design with QLQC Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A wideband circularly polarized (CP) dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is presented in this paper. To obtain wideband CP in proposed antenna, the quasi-lumped quadrature coupler (QLQC) feed network has been investigated with compact size. It has been claimed that excitation of right- and left-handed CP could be controlled by changing input ports. The DRA achieves the favorable broadband characteristics in S band, with 10-dB impedance bandwidth of 62.6% (2.04GHz - 3.9GHz) and 3-dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth of 40.7% (2.42GHz - 3.66GHz). Stable radiation patterns can be realized over the entire operating band while the boresight gain is larger than 4.7dBi.

articleTitle: Dispersion Engineering of Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton: Applications in Achromatic Electromagnetic Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Spoof surface plasmon polariton(SSPP) is typically characteristic by strong dispersion, whose dispersion curve is nonlinear with both weak dispersion at lower frequencies and strong dispersion at higher [1]. frequencies in first Brillouin zone. The rich dispersion property of SSPP provides a possibility for us to tailor the SSPP dispersion curve to realize many types of electromagnetic(EM) devices. In this paper, based on dispersion engineering of SSPP, some applications in microwave achromatic EM devices including reflector and focusing lenses that we have conducted are introduced.

articleTitle: A K-Band Low-cost Phase Shifter for Short-Range FMCW Radar Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a printed circuit board realization of a K-band low-cost phase shifter for short-range FMCW radar is presented. The idea of the phase shifter comes from the vector modulator technique, which based on the concept of vector sum. The proposed phase shifter is consist of a Wilkinson power divider, a quadrature power divider, two DC-blocks and two binary-phase-shift attenuators. Simulated results shows that it is possible to adjust the phase and amplitude simultaneously by changing the bias voltages of the attenuators, and the phase-shift range is 360°. The proposed phase shifter use only four PIN diodes, which achieves low cost, as well as, features continuous phase and amplitude control. PCB of the phase shifter and FMCW radar RF circuit are processed, and further tests are needed.

articleTitle: Low-Frequency Magnetic Shielding Effectiveness of Braided Three-Phase Power Cable Based on 12-Pulse Bridge Rectifier Circuit and PWM Inverter Circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The near magnetic fields of power cables and shielding effectiveness (SE) of cable's braided shield structure are discussed in this paper. The excited current at extreme low frequency (0-400Hz) is provided by a 12-pulse three-phase bridge rectifier or a pulse width modulation (PWM) inverter circuit. Under such excitation, the effects of harmonics can be assessed. Meanwhile, braided metal wires are characterized in terms of hundreds of current filament in 2-D simulation model of cable. Therefore, skin effect and proximity effect are considered in this configuration, which contributes to accurate and high computational efficiency for calculating magnetic fields. Result shows that highly braided copper shielding layer (88%) together with copper strips can lead to large reduction of magnetic fields compared with unprotected counterpart.

articleTitle: GIS-Based Passive Location Method by Inverse Calculation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to overcome the influence of complex geographical environment on location of emitter, this paper proposes a passive localization method by signal magnitude reverse calculation based on GIS (Geographical Information System). In this method, the magnitude of suspected signal source for each monitoring station could be acquire by radio propagation models. Through the comparison of magnitude distribution maps of suspected signal source, the position with equal magnitude is the estimated position. This method converts the distance and direction solving problems into the path attenuation problem, which can effectively reduce the influence of electromagnetic wave diffraction and multipath effects. Through simulation and verification of electromagnetic simulation on software WRAP, it is confirmed that this method can achieve the positioning of unknown signal sources in complex geographical environments.

articleTitle: A Method of Distinguishing the ID and OD Defect of the Pipe under Saturation Magnetization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Distinguishing the inside (ID) and outside (OD) defect is an essential problem for pipeline defect detection in engineering. However, there is no effective way to make it under the condition of saturation magnetization. In this paper, a new method is proposed to distinguish the ID and OD defects under saturation magnetization, which based on the small changes of impedance caused by the flaw eddy current. Compared with the traditional phase shift method, this method shows a better performance on the ID and OD distinguishing. The process of the proposed method is more convenient, practical and reliable.

Author Keywords: Eddy current testing under saturation magnetization
distinguishing of ID and OD defect

articleTitle: Quasi-Periodic Array Modeling Using Reduced Basis with H2-Matrix Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: With the development of electromagnetic theory and fabrication technology, quasi-periodic arrays have been used in many novel electromagnetic devices. These arrays have similar elements located on a periodic lattice. Different from periodic arrays, the elements in a quasi-periodic array are not the same, and the whole array is usually electrically large with multi-scale features. In this work we study fast algorithms for fullwave simulation of quasi-periodic arrays. We apply the reduced basis method to reduce the number of unknowns of the quasi-periodic arrays. To compress the mutual coupling impedance matrix and further accelerate the solution process, we adopt the H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-matrix algorithm and combine it with the reduced basis method. Numerical examples also validate the accuracy and efficiency of this method using integral equation solvers.

articleTitle: Compact Wideband Microstrip Parallel-coupled Line Band-pass Filter With Complementary Electric Field Coupled Resonators
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new resonator which is composed of the cross resonator and the complementary electric coupled-field resonator is proposed. By using the coupled feeding mode, a compact wideband parallel-coupled line band-pass filter with the proposed resonator is presented. The proposed wideband band-pass filter has been simulated, fabricated and measured. It has two transmission zeros outside the pass-band, which improves the selectivity of the proposed wideband band-pass filter. 3 dB bandwidth is 1.81 GHz from 4.07 GHz to 5.88 GHz.

articleTitle: Electro-Thermal Characterization of Microstrip Lines with Impact of Connectors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The electro-thermal characterization of microstrip lines with the impact of connectors is presented in this paper. Firstly, the electrical parameters of microstrip line are extracted by a de-embedding approach. Subsequently, for accurate prediction of the temperature rise of microstrip line with high power inputs, an effective compensation technique is employed which takes into account the effects of heat source and thermal contact resistance of two connectors. Finally, the validity and accuracy of the proposed method are verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Static and Dynamic Scattering Characteristics of Complex Cavity with Rotating Blades
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The scattering characteristics of complex cavity with rotating blades are important information for target recognition. On the one hand, the RCS of a cavity with blades inside varies greatly when the blades rotate at different position. On the other hand, modulation effect will reveal when the blades rotate at high speed. In this paper, the scattering characteristics of a fan model is simulated and tested in static and dynamic states, respectively. Some conclusions are draw which are useful for target recognition.

articleTitle: Design of a low-profile wideband patch antenna with L-shaped feeding mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper has presented the design of a novel low-profile wideband patch antenna. The antenna structure is formed of three layers of substrates with the radiating patches on the top, the grounded patches in the middle and the feeding portion at the bottom. The large operating frequency bandwidth has been obtained due to the L-shaped feeding technique. Moreover, the low cross-polarization level can also be achieved as the feeding structure can be regarded as the preferred differential feeding. The obtained results can confirm that the proposed antenna has achieved a wide impedance bandwidth (VSWR ≤ 2) of about 60% (3-5.5 GHz) and the whole height of the antenna is 6 mm (around 0.06λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">l</sub> at the lowest operating frequency). The obtained cross-polarization level is less than-30dB compared with co-polarization.

articleTitle: A Vector Meshless Method for Transient Vector Wave Equations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Based on the vector radial basis function (RBF) which is theoretical divergence free, we propose a meshless method for solving the transient vector wave equation. Unlike the conventional radial point interpolation meshless (RPIM) method that solves the field components separately, the proposed method solves the vector wave equation directly. Therefore, easy source and boundary implementation is achieved due to the direct solution of the vector wave equation, which is a challenge issue in the traditional RPIM method. Several numerical experiments are taken to validate the accuracy of the proposed solver.

articleTitle: An Effective Stochastic Method for Uncertainty Scattering Analysis of 3-D Objects with Varying Shape
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An effective stochastic method is proposed for uncertainty scattering analysis of 3-D objects with varying shape. Several random variables can be selected to describe the uncertainties of the geometric shape leveraged by the non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) surface modeling approach. All random variables are independent. Then the random variables are derived into the matrix equations. Therefore the scattering properties of the 3-D object with uncertain geometric shape can be quantified by perturbation approach with high efficiency. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Low Profile and High-Performance Cavity Backed Slot Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A low profile cavity backed slot array with 4 sub-arrays is proposed in this paper. By using the non-standard waveguide, the profile of the antenna is reduced to 10mm. Low sidelobe is realized by adjusting the power division ratio of different elements, which is controlled by the coupling coefficient and the location of the ridge. Then, tunable screw is introduced aiming at obtain a better matching. Furthermore, by introducing the Chebyshev low-pass filter (LPF), the antenna can achieve the filtering effect. The simulated and measured results show that the VSWRs of four subarrays are less than 1.65 from 16GHz to 18GHz. The sidelobe level is less than -16dB and the gain is 28dB in the center frequency.

articleTitle: A Low Profile Dual-Band Dual-Polarized Shared-aperture Antenna for Base Station Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a shared-aperture antenna with dual-band, dual-polarization and low profile characteristics for base station applications is presented. The proposed antenna consists of four parts, which are a lower-band element, an upper-band element, a loading metal plate and a reflector. Element are arranged such that the upper-band element is placed above the lower-band element to reduce the coupling between them. The metal plate loaded in the lower-band element could reduce the height of the antenna to realize the low profile characteristic. The simulated results show that stable radiation patterns in the lower band and upper band are obtained. In addition, the port isolation between them higher than 30 dB could be realized.

articleTitle: A Review of Ultra-Wideband Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper reviews development of ultra-wideband (UWB) array antennas. In these existing techniques, the planar UWB array antennas can compromise between cost/ complexity and excellent electrical performance. The technological evolution of planar UWB arrays followed by the design challenges and key technologies are also given.

articleTitle: Three Dimensional Imaging with the Contrast Source Compressive Sampling
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a contrast source compressive sensing method for three-dimensional imaging is presented. A fast Relevance Vector Machine (RVM) is used to find the best hyperparameter vector maximizing the cost function of the problem formulated in a multi-task Bayesian Compressive Sensing (MT-BCS) from which the corresponding equivalent currents and the contrast function of the imaged domain are derived. A comparative assessment is reported in order to show the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Near-field Measurement Sensors Using Full-Wave Numerical Simulator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Generally valid testing method to cope with the weak signal with the contamination, especially, with the electromagnetic compatibility problems is discussed. A new capacitive sensor is designed for those signal levels with poor signal to noise ratio usually come up as problems during the design process; and by using finite-difference time-domain method, numerical model is set up. A carrier frequency system is for the analog part of the sensor electronics providing a low impedance of the receiver resulting in the demanded insensitivity to leakage currents. Data filter is considered with multiple functions to process signal picked up by the sensor. The outstanding performance of such a design has been verified by numerical solver and experiment.

articleTitle: Study on Time-Frequency Calculation and Analysis Method of Frequency Spectrum Characteristic of Transient Frequency Conversion Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The transient frequency conversion signal has the characteristics of short time and time-varying frequency. At present, the frequency spectrum of the interference signal can only be measured by the receiver 0-SPAN mode, which has many problems, such as high cost and time consuming. On the basis of summing up the advantages and disadvantages of time-frequency calculation and analysis methods for transient frequency conversion signals, this paper puts forward a new method of time-frequency computation and analysis of full spectrum filtering and one-sided sparse sample of transient frequency conversion signal. The results of verification show that the proposed calculation and analysis method has high accuracy, wide range of application and reasonable calculation speed.

articleTitle: A Study on Equivalent Circuit Model of RF Discharge Between the Oil-inlet and Nozzle of Aircraft Fuel Tank
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Based on the electromagnetic field and circuit theory, this paper finds the RF discharge in the aircraft fuel tank oil-inlet structure can be described as an equivalent circuit model, and conducts a brief analysis on the RF discharge mechanism by establishing the correlation between circuit parameters of equivalent circuit and plasma characteristics.

articleTitle: Design of Non-Foster Matching Circuits for Electrically-Small Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Electrical-small antennas present large input reactances and small radiation resistances, resulting in high Q value and narrow bandwidth. non-Foster matching circuit is devised to get negative capacitance or negative inductance. In this paper a deep study and analysis on the Non-Foster matching circuit is presented, and a simplified matching circuit of electrically-small monopole antenna is designed at 40 MHz-160 MHz. From the simulation results, the reflection coefficients shown that the proposed circuit can provide wideband performance, which is increased to 60 MHz from 5 MHz.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Aircraft Movement on TACAMO Antenna Radiation Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The electrical characteristics of the TACAMO antenna are closely related to its flight attitude, which in turn is closely linked to the movement of the aircraft platform. This paper combines its flight attitude simulation and numerical algorithm of electrical characteristics, calculates the electrical parameters of the antenna under specific flight parameters, and then briefly analyzes the relationship between the aircraft movement and antenna radiation characteristics, providing a certain degree of follow-up for this type antenna design and development.

articleTitle: Optical forces of a non-paraxial Airy laser-sheet on inhomogeneous particles using discrete-dipole approximation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The application of DDA method is used to compute the optical forces exerted on irregular inhomogeneous particles induced by a non-paraxial Airy laser-sheet using the vector angular spectrum decomposition method.

articleTitle: A Planar Circular Polarization Selective Surface with L-Shape Arms on Single Layer PCB
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a planar circular polarization selective surface (CPSS) with L-shape arms fabricated on single-layer dielectric board. This design has been verified to reflect left-hand circular polarization (LHCP) incident wave while transmit right-hand circular polarization (RHCP) incident wave. More than 30dB high isolation of two types of polarization is realized. This design on single-layer PCB significantly simplifies fabrication procedure, compared with previous 3D or multilayer CPSS. The working principle and design has been studied, which is guidance for CPSS design and application in radar, communication applications.

articleTitle: Propagation Mode in a V-shaped Silicon Groove Waveguide Embedded with Metal Nanowires
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposed a waveguide model consisting of a metal nanowire covered with a dielectric film of low refractive index in a V-shaped silicon groove. Finite element method (FEM) is used to numerically simulate the characteristics of the hybrid plasmonic mode at the wavelength of 1550nm. The simulation results show that the hybrid plasmonic mode can be confined to the dielectric layer on the surface of the metal nanowire, compact mode confinement and low transmission loss can be achieved by adjusting the radius of the metal nanowire and the thickness of the dielectric layer. The overall performance of the proposed model is superior to that of traditional hybrid plasmonic waveguides.

articleTitle: Necessity of Charge Measurement for Field Prediction of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: For field prediction of transmission lines, usually current information is concerned. However, charge, which is the dual field source of current, is necessary to be measured as well as the current in near-field conditions. Although charge could be derived from current theoretically, the error of charge may be much larger than that of current. Such an error transfer effect is considered in this paper and studied on a typical case.

articleTitle: Time of Flight Extraction of Dispersive Lamb Wave by Ridge Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The time of flight (TOF) of Lamb wave is an important inspection data to further analyze the health state of inspected structure in non-destructive evaluation. However, Lamb wave possesses the nature of multi-mode and dispersion, which affects the extraction of TOF negatively. Based on short time Fourier transform (STFT), we propose the method of TOF extraction by ridge analysis. This method extracts the time-frequency ridge in the spectrogram and TOF of corresponding frequency can be obtained utilizing the time information in the ridge. The result shows that the error between TOF and the theoretical time is rather small. The comparison with Hilbert Transform method proves the higher accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Parametric Sparse Recovery Method for TWR Imaging with Unknown Wall Parameter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Radar imaging based on compressive sensing can produce high resolution. However, the wall parameter is unknown in reality. This paper presents a parametric sparse recovery method with unknown wall parameter. The sparse reconstruction problem is a joint optimization one. An efficient algorithm combining orthogonal matching pursuit with least square is proposed to estimate the best wall parameter and recovery the sparse signal. The experiment shows the reliability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Phased Array Imaging with Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper discusses the Compressive Sensing (CS) application in different phased array configurations. Forward imaging models with both far-field beamforming and near-field beamforming techniques are presented. A preliminary set of numerical examples based on digital beamforming (DBF) receiver array are demonstrated to point out advantages of the CS approach over traditional DBF imaging algorithms.

articleTitle: Broadband and Low-profile Microstrip Antennas with Periodical Structures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we have presented two designs of broadband and low-profile microstrip antenna with periodical structures. Broadband performance is mainly achieved by two design principles: Firstly, different periodical radiating patches (strip-slotted or grid-slotted) are applied in proposed antennas to excite TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> mode and antiphase TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub> mode simultaneously; furthermore, antennas are fed by coupling aperture with Y-shaped feeding line, which are utilized to couple two resonant modes together and improve matching performances. Through numerical results, relative bandwidths of two proposed antennas are both higher than 39% with very low profiles of 0.06 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>. Single polarization and dual polarization can be realized by two proposed antennas, respectively. The design concepts offer possibilities for antennas to be integrated in broadband MIMO communication systems.

articleTitle: 2D Magnetotelluric Inversion using Supervised Descent Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we study the 2D magnetotelluric (MT) inversion by a machine learning scheme. Specifically, supervised descent method (SDM), which learns the descent directions of an optimization problem, is applied to MT data inversion. The inversion is composed of offline training and online prediction. In the offline stage, the descent directions can be learned from a set of training data; and in the online stage, data inversion can be achieved by updating the models using the learned directions. SDM offers a more convinient way to incorporate prior information into MT inversion. Furthermore, the learning scheme can achieve fast computation. Numerical tests show that we may be able to reconstruct thin layers from MT data with enough information.

articleTitle: Scattering of Electromagnetic Waves Propagating Through A Steel Rebar Net Reinforced in A Concrete Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) has been widely used for non-destructive evaluation (NDE) of concrete structures, which are usually reinforced by steel rebar. This paper investigates the penetration and scattering of electromagnetic waves through rebar nets. A numerical model simulating an infinite rebar net is established, as shown in Figure 1(a). To save the computation resource and time, only two rebar, respectively in the x and y directions, are modeled. A perfect electric conductor (PEC) condition and a perfect magnetic conductor (PMC) condition are applied to the two boundaries. Consequently, an infinite periodically-spaced rebar net is modelled, according to the mirror’s principle. In this model, two layers of rebar net with an air spacing in the z direction are included.

articleTitle: Application of Electromagnetic Simulation Techniques based on FDTD Method in Human Body Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this study, the radiation efficiency of a dipole antenna inside human body is calculated from 300 MHz to 2 GHz to evaluate the transmission characteristics of electromagnetic wave propagating through human body. Simulation is completed mainly by the finite-different time domain (FDTD) method.

articleTitle: Surface Plasmon Resonance Based on Attenuated Total Reflection
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Surface plasmon resonance has great potential and applications. We present the SPP modes at a planar metal/dielectric interface and analyze metal optical properties based on Drude model, where parameters are fitted by the carried experiment measurements. Two commonly used configurations based on attenuated total reflection, called Otto and Kretschmann-Raether configuration, are analyzed analytically and numerically to excite surface plasmons, which can be helpful for further investigation.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Uniformly Excited Sparse Planar Array Based on Matrix Mapping and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a genetic algorithm (GA) with matrix mapping is proposed for the uniform amplitude sparse planar arrays with multiple constraints, which include the number of elements, the array aperture and the minimum distance between adjacent array elements. The proposed method transforms the multiple constraints problem to an unconstrained problem by establishing two mapping functions. Numerical experiments are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modified Adaptive Cross Approximation Algorithm to Accelerate Impedance Calculation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a method of moments (MoM) based modified adaptive cross approximation (MACA) algorithm is proposed to accelerate the calculation of impedance changes for nondestructive evaluation. Stratton-Chu formulations are selected for MoM to deal with low frequency problems. Numerical results show that MACA algorithm has more memory saving while keeping almost same accuracy as compared to ACA algorithm.

articleTitle: The analysis of arbitrary dispersive models by using AH FDTD method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The time domain finite difference method has been applied in many fields. The convolution operation is necessary for the processing of dispersion medium. It is a frequency-dependent problem, which means that it is represented in the time domain as how to deal with convolution. From the point of view of signal and system, dispersion relation is a kind of system transfer relation. According to AH transformation matrix, the frequency dispersion relation in AH domain can be expressed as a linear relationship based on AH transformation matrix. Therefore, it can be easily embedded into AH FDTD algorithm, and can deal with general dispersion medium problems. The following is a detailed analysis.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect of Ribs on Electrical Impedance Tomography for Thorax Imaging
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This work studies the effect of ribs on the forward simulation of electrical impedance tomography (EIT) for thorax imaging. Models with and without ribs are constructed. Simulated data of these two models are generated and compared. The results show a strong effect of ribs on the simulated data.

articleTitle: Research on the Electromagnetic Scattering Characteristics of two dimensional Non-magnetization plasma
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, Two-dimensional spatially non-uniform plasma sheath model is applied using Z tranform finite-difference Time-domain(Z-FDTD) algorithm to investigate the effects of scattering of Electromagnetic (EM) waves in the plasma sheath. The characteristics of the radar scattering interface (RCS) with different aircraft flight conditions under non-magnetization conditions are analyzed. The changes in RCS at different flight altitudes, Mach numbers and flight angles of attack have been obtained.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Performance UWB Horn Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Broadband horn antenna has been widely used in the EMC measurement, radar and communication system. EMC measurement usually uses standard gain horn antennas. But in practical, for example, it requires 8 standard antennas to test 0.75-18 GHz, which makes the space efficiency of the darkroom reduced. To solve this problem, a 0.7 ~ 18 GHz double-ridged horn antenna is designed and exhibits improved performance in terms of gain, VSWR, and radiation pattern. and the radiation patterns maintain a single main lobe in full band. This denotes that the designed antenna can fulfill higher demands. The fabricated antenna now has been applied to many related field.

articleTitle: Efficient Simulation and Optimization of Nanoloop Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a leap-frog continuous-discontinuous Galerkin time domain (CDGTD) method is proposed to efficiently simulate plasmonic architectures by incorporating the Drude model. The technique is used to perform fast parametric sweeps to study the wideband properties of nanoantennas. Moreover, the covariance matrix adaptation evolutionary strategy (CMA-ES) is employed to optimize an array of nanoloop antennas. A high endfire gain is achieved, which is superior to previously reported results.

articleTitle: A Periodic Thin Dielectric Sheet Integral Method for Scattering Characteristics of Tunable Graphene
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A periodic thin dielectric sheet (PTDS) integral equation method is presented to analyze the scattering of periodic thin graphene films. In this method, the Green's function in free space is replaced by the periodic Green's function to reduce the scale of calculation. In addition, only the surface of the thin dielectric sheet needs to be meshed. Numerical examples are presented to show the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Compressive Processing of Microwave Data for NDE/NDT
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In the framework of nondestructive evaluation and testing (NDE/NDT), this paper deals with the retrieval of unknown defects inside known dielectric media. A Bayesian Compressive Sensing contrast source inversion method enabled by a suitable definition of the inhomogeneous Green's function is employed to fully exploit the a-priori information of the problem at hand, regarding the knowledge on the unperturbed structure and the physical sparseness of the perturbations. Selected numerical results are presented in order to assess effectiveness and robustness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Cramér-Rao Bounds for Non-Uniform Linear Cocentered Orthogonal Loop and Dipole Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we derive and analyze Cramér-Rao bounds for angle and polarization parameters of time-varying narrowband far-field azimuthal plane waves arriving at a non-uniform linear COLD (co-centered orthogonal loop and dipole) array. Numerical simulation results illustrate the behavior of the COLD array performance with respect to sensor numbers, array geometry, array aperture, and confirm the validity of the obtained CRB expressions.

Author Keywords: co-centered orthogonal loop and dipole array

articleTitle: Reduction of Mutual Coupling for Vivaldi Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Mutual coupling between antennas is a widespread problem that may affect the performance of wireless systems. This work tries to solve such a problem for Vivaldi antennas. A method based on characteristic mode analysis (CMA) is used to analyze and reduce mutual coupling between Vivaldi antennas without changing the impedance bandwidth. Meanwhile, the radiation pattern of the Vivaldi antenna is improved due to the reduction of mutual coupling in low frequency range.

articleTitle: A Multiband Folded Loop Antenna for Metal-Rimmed Smartphones
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A folded loop antenna for mobile phones surrounded by a metal rim is presented in this paper. The loop antenna has four resonant modes at working bands. By taking advantage of the metal rim, the antenna can cover GSM850, GSM900, DCS1800, PCS1900, UMTS2100, LTE2300 and LTE2500 operating bands. The antenna is studied using simulation method.

articleTitle: Scattered Fields from a Three-dimensional Complex Target Moving at High Speed
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The scattered properties of a three-dimensional almond-shaped target, moving at high speed, is analyzed by the Lorentz-FDTD method. Numerical results show that the amplitude and frequency of the scattered wave are modulated due to the moving speed of the target.

articleTitle: High efficiency rectifier design at 5.8 GHz with high input power for microwave power transmission application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A single shunted rectifier with an HSMS 2820 Schottky diode for high input power at 5.8 GHz is presented in this paper. The simulation result shows that the maximum conversion efficiency is 75.5% at 28.6dBm input power and with a 160Ω DC load resistance.

articleTitle: A Single-Layer High-Efficiency Broadband Reflectarray Antenna Using Thin Membrane
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A broadband reflectarray element based on single-layer thin membrane is proposed in this letter. The measure gain is 28.37 dBi at the centre frequency of 10 GHz for the proposed antenna, whose aperture efficiency is 50.6%. Moreover, the measured peak sidelobe for both planes are under -22 dB and the 1-dB gain bandwidth of antenna can reach 24.4%, which implying the antenna features the characteristic of broadband. All measured results show that good radiation performance can be achieved for the proposed antenna, which is a good candidate for the shape of special aperture in targeted application.

articleTitle: Design of Substrate Integrated Waveguide Based Filtering Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, antennas with filtering responses for both input return loss and radiation gain, are analyzed by filter synthesis method and designed with substrate integrated waveguide resonators, to obtain better suppressions against out-of-band signals and functional array designs for practical applications.

articleTitle: SIW Cavity-Backed Dual-Polarized Shorted Annular Patch Antenna with High Gain
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An SIW cavity-backed shorted annular patch (SAP) antenna with high gain and dual polarization operation at X band is presented. The upper layer is the shorted annular patch and the lower layer is the microstrip feed network. The microstrip line feeds the shorted annular patch through the sectorial annular slot on the ground. The SIW cavity structure is loaded around upper layer and the gain is increased by about 2 dB. Simulation results show that the antenna has a bandwidth from 11.2 to 11.75 GHz at both polarizations and a high port isolation of better than 28 dB. A high broadside peak gain of 10.6 dBi is achieved within the operation band.

articleTitle: Investigation of the RCS for a finite bandpass frequency selective surface
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Frequency selective surface (FSS) of finite size behaves differently with respect to an ideal infinite one due to the influence of fringe effect. The study on RCS of a finite FSS can quantitatively reveal the mechanism of the fringe effect, while there exist little study concerning this subject. This paper presents study of RCS for FSS with finite structures. The RCS for different sizes of FSS under plane wave illumination are studied. Quantitative relations between fringe effect and dimension of FSS are summarized. A new case is finally picked and tested to verify the validity of the relations.

articleTitle: An X-band Reconfigurable Reflectarray Antenna with Steerable Monopulse Patterns
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An electronically steerable monopulse antenna based on reconfigurable reflectarray antenna (RRA) has been designed, fabricated and tested. The large-scale RRA at X-band is consisted of 160×64 elements integrated with PIN diodes, and is controlled by arrays of 160 field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) in parrallel, for the steerable monopulse patterns. The steerable sum-difference beams are achieved by the diode state distributions of the RRA. The gain of the RRA is measured to be 37.35dBi, and the null-depth is measured to be -43.51dB at the direction angle of 0°. A null-depth of under -37.54dB is verified at the direction angle of 60°. The electronically steerable monopulse antenna based on RRA presents a low-cost solution for high resolution tracking applications.

articleTitle: Propagation of Electromagnetic Waves In the On-Chip Power Tracks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper analyzes frequency response of the on-chip power distribution network (OCPDN) with tracks in the millimeter wave range. A theoretical model based on transmission line theory is established to explain the behavior of the OCPDN. The model shows that OCPDN can block the propagation of electromagnetic wave in certain frequency range. Wide stopbands exist. Full wave simulation based on HFSS has been performed to verify the model. The simulation results matched the results from the model, indicating the validation of the model. The behavior of the OCPDN provides important information for integrated circuit design.

articleTitle: Characteristic Mode Synthesis of Scanning Beam Patterns for Aircraft Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Structural antenna concept attracts much attention in low frequency platform-integrated antenna designs. Because the size of VHF antennas is usually very large, it is conventionally challenging to mount multiple such antennas on an aircraft to obtain high gain and beam scanning ability. In this paper, an approach is developed to synthesize scanning beam patterns using the characteristic modes of an aircraft in VHF band. Broadside and scanned beam patterns with scan angle of 15°, 30°, and 45° in E-plane are synthesized and found approximated well to the designated patterns. The synthesized currents in the four cases give useful information on the optimal antenna element mounting locations for the excitation of the composite characteristic currents.

articleTitle: Design of a Miniature High-Pass Filter Using LTCC Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A miniature high-pass filter using the stripline structure with low temperature co-fired ceramic technology is presented. A lumped element circuit model is used to synthesize the designed filter, and the full-wave simulator HFSS is used to finalize the design. Experiments have been used to verify the design. And the measured prototype shows good performance, including a compact size, light weight, high selectivity and low insertion loss. The size of the fabricated prototype is $ 10\mathrm {m}\mathrm {m}\times 9.86\mathrm {m}\mathrm {m}(0.268\lambda_{0}\times 0.265\lambda_{0})$, where $\lambda_{0}$ is the free-space wavelength at the cut-off frequency 8.05GHz. The investigated filter can be a promising candidate for wireless systems.

articleTitle: A High-Gain Orbital Angular Momentum Antenna Array Based on Parasitic Composite Slabs
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a high-gain orbital angular momentum (OAM) antenna array based on parasitic composite slabs. Dielectric constant, thickness of the slabs, and resonant height are introduced and optimized to design the parasitic slabs for a high gain achievement. The optimized parasitic composite slabs are made out of three slabs of different dielectric constants, two of them touching each other. The maximum realized gain is confirmed to be enhanced by 6 dB for OAM wave, and the divergent angle of OAM wave is effectively concentrated with the well-designed high-gain orbital angular momentum antenna array.

articleTitle: A Novel Multiple-traces Electric Field/Combined Field Integral Equation for Electromagnetic Modeling of Microstrip Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new multiple-traces electric field/combined field integral equation (MT-EF/CFIE) is proposed for the electromagnetic modeling of microstrip objects. Different from traditional EFIE-PMCHWT method, this new multiple-traces method decomposes the original microstrip object into two independent domains i.e., the exterior region (free space) and interior region (microstrip), and enforces the Robin transmission conditions (TCs) on the interface between exterior and interior regions to ensure the continuity of fields. In comparison to the traditional EFIE-PMCHWT, this new MT-EF/CFIE has a better convergence property. Because the continuity of fields is ensured by TCs, the exterior and interior regions can be discretized by non-conformal meshes, which improves the flexibility and efficiency of the proposed methods substantially.

articleTitle: Design of Printed Wideband dipole with High Gain and Anti-interference Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A printed wideband dipole with high gain and anti-interference characteristic is designed in this paper. The antenna is composed of two microstrip open-loop resonators, a parallel coupled line, a wideband dipole, and two radiation guide lines. The parallel coupled line is designed as an admittance converter. It is used to connect the wideband dipole and the microstrip open-loop resonator. The dipole performs not only radiator, but also a resonator of the filter. The radiation guide lines are used to increase the gain of the dipole. Simulation results show that the integrated dipole has high gain, good impedance bandwidth and out-of-band rejection characteristic.

articleTitle: Transient Responses of Broadband Low Profile filter-antenna Under Impact of an EMP
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The time-domain responses of some broadband low profile microstrip filter-antenna of the complex electrical information system in the presence of an exterior electromagnetic pulses (EMP) is studied in this conference paper. An efficient numerical method based on conformal FDTD method is implanted for studying an EMP coupling with some typical broadband low profile microstrip filter-antennas widely used in the different communication systems. The induced time-domain voltages and currents characteristics of the antenna illuminated by different incident EMPs are shown and compared in detail.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-polarized Frequency Selective Absorbers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents the design and investigation of dual-polarized frequency selective absorbers. The absorber are consists of two layers. The square loop resonators with lumped resistors are the lossy layers, while the lossless layers are ground with square slots. The frequency selective absorbers exhibit broad absorption bands at the sides of passbands. The designed absorber transmits in-band wave and absorbs the incoming out-of-band wave. Hence, it can be applied as a radome and has potential for radar stealth application.

articleTitle: Measurement of Temperature Dependence Complex Permittivity Based on Fitting Algorithm of Terminal short circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Aiming at the measurement of temperature dependence complex permittivity of low loss material, a new fitting algorithm is designed based on terminal short circuit method. The calculation process is simpler and remain accuracy. At the same time the temperature dependence test system is designed and built in this paper. The accuracy of the algorithm and the system is verified. The results show that the complex permittivity of low loss materials can be accurately measured from room temperature to 250<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>C under the wide band.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Characteristic Analysis of Low Noise Amplifier Using Volterra Series
publicationTitle: 2018 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The low noise amplifier (LNA) is a commonly device used in RF front-end. In this paper, a third-order nonlinear theoretical model of LNA based on Volterra series is proposed. The expression of the power of fundamental signal and third-order intermodulation signal when the input signal is a dual-frequency signal are given. The correctness and accuracy of the theoretical model is verified by the good agreement between the measured data and simulated data.
